verses.text: David’ tapa Solomon pen ama kumpigam ah kikipsak a, Yahweh a Pa in amah ompih-in, nakpi-in a tawisang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Israyl khempeuh tung, a tultul ukte tung, a zaza ukte tung, thukhente tung, leh amau beh teka beh lutangte ahi Israyl sung khempeuh a makaite khempeuh tungah thu a gen hi.

Tua ciangin Gibeon-a mun sang ah Solomon leh ama tawh a om mihon khempeuh paito uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ nasempa Mosheh in sehnel gama a bawlsa Yahweh’ mihonpite Kikhopna Puanbuk pen tua lai-ah a om hi.

(Ahih hangin David in Kiryath Yearim panin a koih nadingin David bawlkholhna mun ah Yahweh’ singkuang a paipihto hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yerusalem ah a koih nading puanbuk khat a lamsak khin hi.)
Tu-in Hur’ tapa Uri’ tapa Bezaleel lamsa sumngo biaknatau pen Yahweh biakbuk mai-ah tua lai-ah a kikoih hi; tua takah Solomon leh mihonte in Amah thu a dong uh hi.
Kikhopna Puanbuk-a om Yahweh mai-a sumngo biaknatau ah Solomon pai-in, tua tungah meihal biakna tul khat a pia hi.
Tua zanin Solomon tungah Yahweh kilangin ama kiangah, “Hong ngen in! Nang tungah bang hong pia ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Yahweh kiangah, “Nangmah in ka pa David tungah hehpihna lianpi lakin, ama mun ah kumpi-in kei nong bawlkhin hi.
Tu-in Yahweh ka Pa aw, ka pa David tunga na ciamna kikipsak tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh leitunga leivui bangin a tam minam khat tungah kumpi-in kei nong bawlkhin hi.
Hih mite makaih zia ding ka theih nadingin pilna leh theihna hong pia in; bang hang hiam cihleh nangma aa hih zaha a tam mite kua-in thukhen thei ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Solomon kiangah, “Hih thu na lungsim sungah omin, nangmah in neihlelam, hauhna leh pahtawina ahi a, na galte nuntakna ahi zongin nong ngen kei a, nuntak sauna zong hong ngen loin, amaute tunga kumpi-in kong bawl Ka mite na thu na khen theih nadingin pilna leh theihna hong ngen na hih manin—
pilna leh theihna hong kipia pah a, nang ma-a kumpi kuamah in a ngah ngei loh, nang khita kumpi kuamah in zong a ngah nawn loh ding neihlelam, hauhna leh pahtawina-te nang kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gibeon-a mun sang pan, Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-panin Solomon paikhia-in Yerusalem ah pai-in Israyl-te a uk hi.
Solomon in sakolleengte leh sakol tung tuangte kaikhawm hi. Amah in sakolleeng 1,400 leh sakol tung tuang 12,000 nei a, amah in sakolleeng khuapite leh kumpipa omna Yerusalem tuate a koih hi.
Kumpipa in Yerusalem ah suang bangin ngun olsak a, amah in Shephelah-a; mualbul-a, theiba kung zahin tamtak sing a tamsak mahmah hi.
Solomon in Egypt leh Keveh panin sakolte la hi. Kumpipa’ sumbawlte in Keveh ah sum tawh a lei ahi hi.

Sakol khat ciangin ngun shekel 150-in kizuak hi. Amaute in Egypt panin sakolleeng khat ciangin ngun shekel 600-in la a, sakolte zong a la uh hi. Amau khut panin amaute in Hit mite kumpite khempeuh leh Aram mite kumpite kiangah tuate zuaksawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Yahweh’ Min aa dingin Inn khat leh ama aa dingin kumpi-inn khat a kilam nadingin thu a pia hi.
Solomon in van pua dingin mi 70,000, mual kawma suang at dingin mi 80,000 leh amau nasepna a uk ding mi 3,600 a seh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Solomon in Tyre kumpipa Hiram kiangah thupuakin, “Tenna ding inn khat a lam nadingin taamtakte puakin, ka pa David aa dingin na hihsa bang teekteekin kei aa dingin zong hong hihsak in.

En in, Israyl-te tungah tawntung ngeina-in a kisehsaksa mah bangin Ama mai-ah a namtui nate ahi paknamtui a kihal theih nading; Ama mai-ah ompihna anlum piak tawntung nading; Zingsang leh Nitak meihal biaknate piak tawntung nading; Shabbat nite, Kha Thak nite leh a kiseh Yahweh kote Pa’ Pawi nite-a biakpiaknate ka piak theih nadingun keimah in Ama tungah ap-in Yahweh ka Pa Min aa dingin Inn khat a lam ding ka hi hi.
Tua hi a, ka lam ding Inn pen lian ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote Pa pen pasiante (elohim) khempeuh sangin lianzaw hi.

Ahih hangin vantung leh a sangpen vantung-te nangawn in Amah huam zolo ahih nungsangin kua in Ama aa ding Inn khat lamsak thei ding ahi hiam? Ama mai-ah paknamtui hal ding simloh Ama aa dingin Inn a lamsak dingin kei kua hilel ka hi hiam?

Tua ahih manin kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, a ausan, a dupsan leh a dum nate ah nasep a siam, tuate bangci kuak ding cih a thei mi khat na a sem dingin tu-in kei kiangah hong sawl in. Amah in ka pa David sehsa Yahdah leh Yerusalem kei tawh a om khutsiamte tawh sem khawm ding hi. 8-9 Ka lam ding Inn pen lianin thupi kul ding ahih manin kei aa dingin sing tampi ka kigin theih nadingin Lebanon panin taamtak, taksan, leh cingsing luangte hong puak in; bang hang hiam cihleh na khutnuai mite singphuk a siam lam ka thei hi; tua hi a, keima khutnuai mite in nang ma khutnuai mite huh ding uh hi.

Sing nasem sing phuk nangma khutnuai mite aa dingin mangbuh gawisa kor 20,000; seng 125,000 kiim, mangbuh-ham kor 20,000, leenggahzu bath 20;gallon 115,000, leh a kigawi sathau bath 20,000 ka sik ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Tyre kumpi Hiram in laigelhin dawng a, Solomon tungah thupuakin, “Yahweh in a mite it ahih manin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong bawl hi!” a ci hi.

Hiram in, “Vantung leh leitung a bawl Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh kiphat tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh Amah in thuthuk muhna leh thu theihtelna a nei ta pasal pil khat Kumpi David piakhin a, amah pen Yahweh aa dingin Inn khat leh ama aa dingin kumpi-inn khat a lam dingpa ahi hi,” a cih beh lai hi.
Tu-in keimah in khutsiamte a makaih a siam mahmah mi khat kong sawl khin a, ama min Huram ahi hi.

Amah pen Dan’ tanute laka numei’ khat tapa hi a, ahih hangin a pa pen Tyre mi ahi hi. Amah pen keima lawm na pa David’ khutsiamte leh nangma khutsiamte tawh a kikhuak nasep peuhpeuh sem ding, ahih keileh ama tunga na gen lim bangbangin a bawl thei ding kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, suang, sing, a dupsan, a dum, saihadial puanhoih leh a sanciik nasepte ah a siam mi khat ahi hi.
Tu-in ka ukpa’ gensa mangbuh, mangbuh-ham, sathau leh leenggahzu-te, na nasemte tungah hihte hong puak in;

tua ciangin kote in Lebanon panin na deih zahzah sing ka phuk ding uh hi. Kote in phong tawh tuipi tawnin Yaffo ah kong puak ding uh a, tua ciangin nangmah in Yerusalem ah na puato thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in a pa David lak misimna mah bangin Israyl gam sunga a teng gamdangmi khempeuh misimna nei a, amaute 153,600 a pha hi.
Amah in amaute lak panin 70,000 pen van pua ding, 80,000 pen mual kawma suang at ding leh 3,600 pen mite nasepna enin a uk dingin a seh hi.
Solomon in Yebus mi Ornan (Araunah) ancilna phual, a pa David tunga Yahweh a kilatna mun Moriyah Mual tung Yerusalem ah Yahweh’ Inn lam ding kipan hi.
Ama uk zawh a kum lina kum, a Kha Nihna kha a ni nih ni-in amah in a lam dingin a kipan hi.
Yahweh’ Inn lam nadingin Solomon phuh innbulpi pen (khanglui na tehna tawh kizui-in) tong 60 sau-in tong 20 a zai hi.
Yahweh’ Inn a mai-a lapkaihna pen a innvai mah tawh kikimin tong 20; pi 30 kiim, hi a, tong 20; pi 30 kiim, mah sang hi. Kham citak tawh a sunglam kizut hi.
Amah in Siangtho Mun pen taksan sing tawh a kawm dapin tua tungah nisuh kungte leh khainiang lim khuakin, tua khit ciangin kham hoih tawh a zut hi.
Amah in suang manphate leh Parvaim pana khamte tawh Inn a hoih mahmahin a zem hi.
Amah in kawmte tungah cherub-te suai-in, tua khit ciangin innsunte, sangkilte, kawmte leh kongkhakte, kham tawh a zut hi.
Amah in adung avai tong 20; pi 30 kiim, sau-in a zai Siangthopen Mun a lam hi. Amah in kham hoih talent 600 tawh Siangthopen Mun a zut hi.
A kilhnate’ gikna pen kham shekel 50 ahi hi. Amah in a inn dawl tungnungte zong kham tawh a zut hi.
Siangthopen Mun sungah amah in lim bawlsiamte sep cherub nih bawlin kham tawh tuate a zut hi.
Tua cherub tegel’ kha a kizalin tong 20 sau hi. Cherub masa’ kha pen tong 5 sau a, tua in hih inn kawm bana, adang khat’ kha zong tong 5 mah sau-in cherub khatpen’ kha a ban hi.
Tua mah bangin a nihna cherub’ kha khat in hih inn kawm langkhat banin a kha langkhat zong tong 5 mah sau a, cherub masa pen’ kha a ban hi.
Hih cherub tegel khate pen tong 20 sau hi. Amaute in a sunglam maingatin a khe un a ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin a dum, a dupsan, a sanciik leh saihadial puan hoih tawh Dalna puan bawlin tua tungah cherub-te a tungsak hi.
Amah in inn mai aa dingin tong 35; pi 52 kiim, a sang khuampi nih bawl hi. Tuate dawna khuamlu zepnate pen tong 5 a sang hi.
Amah in ngawnga a ki-ok khi bang khainiang bawlin, khuampite dawn ah a koih hi. Amah in mang kawlsing zakhat bawlin, khainiangte tungah a koih hi.

Amah in Yahweh’ Inn mai-ah khuampite a taklam ah khat, a veilam ah khat phutin, a taklama khuampi’ min pen Yachin; Ama’n kipsak ding hi, ci-in a veilama khuampi’ min pen Boaz; Ama sungah Thahatna, a ci hi.
Amah in tong 20 a sau, tong 20 mah a zai, tong 10 a sang sumngo biaknatau khat a bawl hi.
Amah in daal sungin Tuipi bawl a, a bemsak hi; a geivial panin a geivial khat dong tong 10 ahi hi. A sanna tong 5 hi a, a gei kiimkot tong 30 a pha hi.
A geivial nuai-ah bawngtal limte in umcih a, tong khat ah sawm ta a om hi. Bawngtalte gualnihin Tuipi tawh sakhatin kisung khawm hi.

Bawngtal sawm le nih tungah Tuipi kinga hi: thum in leilu lam maingatin, thum in nitumna lam maingatin, thum in leitaw lam maingatin, thum in nisuahna lam a maingat hi. Tuate tungah Tuipi kinga a, kinungngat dimdiam uh hi.
Tuipi pen khutpeek khatcia sah a, hai ahih keileh unok paak bangin geivial a nei hi. Tua sungah tui bath 3,000; gallon 17,500 kiim, a kita hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in kisil nadingin tuikuang 10 bawlin, leitaw lamah nga koihin, leilu lam ah nga a koih hi. A kikhin thei leengte tunga kikoih hih kisilna kuangte pen meihal biakna dinga nazatte silsiang nadingin a kizang ahi hi; ahih hangin Tuipi pen siampite kisil nading ahi hi.
Amah in a kigeelsa tawh kizui-in kham meivak khuam sawm bawl a, Siangtho Mun sungah koihin, a taklam pangah nga, a veilam pangah nga a koih hi.
Amah in sabuai sawm zong bawlin, Siangtho Mun sungah koihin, a taklam pangah nga, a veilam pangah nga a koih hi; tua ciangin amah in kham tawh thawl gongbak zakhat zong a bawl hi.
Amah in siampite’ inntual leh inntual zapi leh inntual kongkhakte tawh a bawl khawm hi; tua khit ciangin amah in hih kongkhakte sumngo tawh a zut hi.
Amah in leitaw lampang leitaw-nisuahna lam kiu ah Tuipi a koih hi.
Huram in leibeel; vut koihna, kawbiate leh tuithehna thawl gongbakte a bawl hi. Tua hi a, Kumpi Solomon aa dingin Yahweh’ Inn ah a sem dingin a kiseh nasep Huram in a zo hi:
Khuampi nihte leh thawl gongbak tawh a kibang khuampi nihte tunga khuamlu zepnate; khuampite tunga om thawl gongbak tawh a kibang khuamlu zepna a tuam ngen bangin a kibawl nihte;
Ngen a bang nihte aa dingin mang kawlsing zali (khuampite dawna thawl gongbak tawh a kibang khuamlu zepna a zem ngen khat aa dingin mang kawlsing gual nihta ahi hi);
Amah in meihal biakpiaknate sil nadingin leengtunga tuikuangte aa dingin a kikhin thei leengte zong a bawl hi.
Tuipi khat leh a nuai-a bawngtal sawm le nihte;
Vut koihna ding leibeelte, kawbiate, sa thukna sikkeukate leh vanzat adang a kisam khempeuh zong Huram in Yahweh’ Inn-a ding Kumpi Solomon aa dingin a kinawtpaak sumngo tawh a bawl hi.
Succoth leh Zeredah kikal Yardan zanglei sung beel lei-ah kumpipa in hihte sungsak hi.
Solomon bawlsak hih nazatte khempeuh tamlua mahmah a, sumngo a gikzah kithei zolo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Yahweh’ Inn-a Mun Siangtho aa dingin nazatte khempeuh bawlsak hi. Tuate in: kham biaknatau, ompihna anlum koihna sabuai,
a kigeelsa bangin munsiangtho sungnung mai-ah; Siangtho Mun sungah, vak dingin kham citak tawh kibawl meivak khuamte tawh a meivakte,
kham kibawl paak leh meivakte leh taitehte—hihte khempeuh kham hoihpen tawh kibawl hi a,

kham citak tawh kibawl meitehnate, tuithehna thawl gongbakte, sikkeu liangsaute leh paknamtui beelte; leh Yahweh’ Inn kham kongkhakte ahi Siangthopen Mun sung lutna a sunglam kongkhakte leh Mun Siangtho lutna a pualam kongkhakte ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Yahweh’ Inn-a dingin a sehsa nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin Solomon in a pa David apsa ngun, kham, leh nazatte khempeuh lutpihin, tua ciangin amah in Yahweh’ Inn van manpha koihnate ah tuate a koih hi.
Solomon in Zion kici David Khuapi panin Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a lak theih nadingin Yerusalem ah Israyl upate, minam lutangte khempeuh leh Israyl mi beh makaite a sam hi.
A Kha Sagihna kha sunga Buk Pawi ah kumpipa tawh Israyl mi khempeuh a kikaikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl upate khempeuh hong tungin, Levi mite in singkuang a domto uh hi;
Tua khit ciangin amaute in singkuang, Kikhopna Puanbuk leh biakbuk sunga om a siangtho nazatte khempeuh a puato uh hi. Siampite leh Levi mite in tuate puato uh hi;
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon leh ama kiima kikhawm Israyl mihon buppi in singkuang mai-ah a kisim zolo a kiciamteh zolo tuu leh bawngtal tampi tawh biakpiakna a pia uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin siampite in Yahweh’ Inn biakinn a sungnung munsiangtho sung ama om nading mun; Siangthopen Mun, ah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang paipih-in, cherub-te kha nuai-ah a koih uh hi.
Cherub-te in singkuang kikoihna mun tungah a khate uh zal a, cherub-te in singkuang leh a puakna zawlte tung teng a liah hi.

Ahih hangin singkuang panin a dawkkhia a zawlte sau mahmah a, a sungnung munsiangtho mai; Siangtho Mun sung, panin kimu a, ahih hangin Mun Siangtho pualam panin tuate a kimu kei hi. Tua hi a, tuni dongin tua lai-ah omlai hi.
Egypt panin a paikhiat uh ciangin Yahweh in Israyl mite tawh thuciamna khat a bawl lai-in Horeb-a Mosheh in a koih suangpeek nihte lobuang singkuang sungah bangmah dang a om kei hi.
Tua khit ciangin Siangthopen Mun panin siampite hong pusuakkhia uh hi. (Tua hun lai-in kua pawl cih om loin tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh amau mah a kisiansuah tawm uh hi.)

Tua ciangin Levi mi lasate, Asaph, Heman leh Yeduthun amau tapate leh a sanggamte tawh biaknatau nisuahna lamah dingin saihadial puan hoihte silh a, daltuahte, harp khausaite leh zither khausaite a tum uh hi. Amaute, peengkul muut; chatsotserot, siampi 120 tawh a kithuah uh hi.

Peengkul muutte leh lasate aw khata gingin Yahweh tungah lungdam ko ding leh a phat dingin a kigawm uh hi. Peengkulte, daltuahte, harp khausaite leh zither khausaite tawh kopin Yahweh tungah phatna awte sangsak uh a, “Amah thumaan hi! Ama itna leh hehpihna kip tawntung hi!” ci-in a sa uh hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn meii tawh kidim a,
tua ciangin meii hangin siampite in nasep a zom thei kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ Inn sungah Yahweh’ minthanna a dim hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, “Yahweh in meii sahpi sungah ka teng ding hi, ci hi.
Ahih hangin a tawntungin na tenna ding, a kitawisang Inn khat nang aa dingin ka lamkhin hi!” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin kumpipa kihei a, Israyl mihon khempeuh a din laitakin amah in Israyl mihon khempeuh thupha a pia hi.
Amah in, “Ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a ciamsa a khut tawh a semkhia Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa kiphat tahen—amah in:

‘Egypt gam panin Ka mite ka paikhiatpih ni-a kipanin Ka Min a om nadingin Israyl minam khatpeuh panin Inn khat a lam nading khuapi khat beek ka teel kei a, Ka mi Israyl-te a uk dingin zong mi khatpeuh ka teel kei hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in tua lai-ah Ka Min a om theih nadingin Keimah in Yerusalem ka teelkhin a, tua ciangin Ka mi Israyl-te a uk dingin David ka teelkhin hi,’ ci hi.
Tu-in Israyl’ Pa Yahweh’ Min aa dingin Inn khat lam ding ka pa David lungsim sungah om a,
ahih hangin Yahweh in ka pa David kiangah, ‘Ka Min aa dingin Inn khat lam ding na lungsim sungah om ahih manin na lungsim sunga hih thu na neih pen a hoih ahi hi.
Ahi zongin nangmah in Inn na lam ding a, ahih hangin nangma cilesa na sisan ahi na tapa in Ka Min aa dingin Inn lam ding hi,’ ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in a ciamsa thu kemcing a, ka pa David mun ka luahkhin hi. Yahweh’ ciamsa bang teekteekin Israyl kumpi-tokhom tungah ka tu a, Israyl’ Pa Yahweh’ Min aa dingin Inn ka lamkhin hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl mite tawh a bawl Yahweh’ thuciamna a koihna singkuang tua lai-ah ka koih khin hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl mihon khempeuh omin Yahweh’ biaknatau mai-ah Solomon dingin a khutte zankhia a,

(Tu-in Solomon in tong 5 a sau, tong 5 a zai, tong 3 a sang sumngo tau khat bawlin inntual laizangah a koih khin hi. Tua tungah amah dingin, Israyl mihon khempeuh mai-ah khukdinin vantung lamah a khutte zakkhia hi)

tua ciangin a gen inah: “Yahweh, Israyl Pa aw, a lungsim khempeuh tawh Nang hong zongin Nangma mai-a a kalsuan na nasemte aa dingin na itna leh na thuciamna a lenkip vantung leitung ah Nang tawh a kibang pasian (el, elohim) khat beek omlo hi.
Nangmah in na nasem ka pa David tunga na ciamsa na lenkip hi; tuni-a mah bangin Nangmah in na kam tawh genin na khut tawh na sem hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa aw, na nasem ka Pa David tungah, ‘Ka mai-a na kalsuan bang teekteekin Ka Thukham bangin a kalsuan nadingun na tapate kidawm takin a kalsuan nak uh leh, Israyl kumpi tokhom tunga a tu dingin keima muhna ah mi khat beek na tasam kei ding hi,’ ci-in na ciamsa hong lenkip in.
Tu-in Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa aw, na nasempa David tunga na ciamsa thu hong tangtungsak in.
Ahih hangin leitung ah mite tawh Yahweh hong teng takpi ding ahi hiam? Vantungte, a sangpen vantungte nangawn in nang hong huam zolo uh hi! Keima lamsa hih Inn in hong huam zolo zaw kan ding hi!
Ahi zongin Yahweh ka Pa aw, na nasempa thungetna leh hong thuumna hong don inla, na mai-a na nasempa kong kikona leh thuumin kong thungetna hong ngai in.
Sun leh zanin hih inn lamah na mitte hong inla, Na Min koih ding na cihna hih mun hong mu in. Hih mun lam nga-in na nasempa kong thungetna hong za inla,
amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin na nasempa leh na mi Israyl-te’ hong thuumnate hong za in. Vantunga na tenna mun panin hong za in, na zak ciangin hong maisak in.
Mi khatpeuh in a sanggampa tungah khialin, kiciam kul a, amah hong pai-in na biaknatau mai hih Inn ah hong kiciam leh,

vantung panin hong za inla hong sem in. Na nasemte kikalah thu hong khen inla, ama gamtatna bangin ama lu tung mah ah tuksakna tawh mawhna thuk inla, a mawhbaang lo thumaan mipa kipsakna tawh a mawh lohna hong pulakkhia in.

Tua bang hi loin na mi Israyl-te in nangma tunga hong mawhna uh hangin a galte mai-ah kizogawpin, ahih hangin amaute kihei-in Nangma Min pulakin, tua ciangin hih Inn sung nangma mai-ah thu hong genin thuumna hong bawl uh leh,
vantung panin za inla, na mi Israyl-te mawhna maisak in; tua ciangin amaute tung leh a pu a pate uh tunga na piak gam ah amaute ciahpihkik in.

Na mite in nang tungah hong mawhna uh hangin vantungte kikhakcipin guah a zuk loh ciang, amaute hih mun lamah thungenin Na Min hong pulak uh a, a mawhna uh panin a kihei uh ciangin, amaute nasakkhin na hih manin,
vantung panin za inla, na mi Israyl, na nasemte mawhna maisak in; tua ciangin a zuih dingun thuman lampi na hilh ding a, a luah dingin na mite tungah na piak gam tungah guah na zusak ding hi.

Gam sungah kialpi ahi a, pulpi ahi a, ankung siatna ahi a, ankung maibuakna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, kaukhup ahi a, amau khuapite khatpeuh ah a galte in a umcih ciang ahi a, siatna khatpeuh natna khatpeuh a om ciang,
Na mi Israyl khempeuh ahi a, khatpeuh in ahi zongin thungetna ahih keileh thuumna hong bawlin, amau thuakna leh natna ciat phawkin, hih Inn lama a khutte a zakkhiat uh ciangin—

Na tenna vantung panin za inla maisak in; tua ciangin ama lungsim thei na hih nungsangin ama sepna khempeuh tawh kizui-in ama tungah tungsak in (bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah bek in mihingte lungsim na thei hi);

Levi mite in amau neihkhop-gamte leh amau neihsate nusia-in, Yahdah leh Yerusalem ah a kituah uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yeroboam leh a tapate in Yahweh tungah a nasepna uh siampi’ zum panun amaute hemkhia hi;
tua tangin amah in Mun Sangte tawh a kikop Innte aa ding, dawite (pasiante, elohim) aa ding, leh ama bawlsa biaknatau a kualte aa dingin ama aa sung panin siampite a seh hi.
Israyl minam khempeuh lak panin Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa zonna ah a lungsim uh a koih mite in Yahweh a Pa uh Pawite bawl dingin Yerusalem ah Levi-te a zui uh hi.
Amaute in Yahdah kumpipa thakhauhsakin, Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam kum thum sung a panpih uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh David leh Solomon’ lampi ah kum thum sung amaute a kalsuan uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Rehoboam in David’ tapa Yerimoth’ tanu Mahalath tenpih a, Mahalath’ nu pen Yishai’ tapa Eliab’ tanu Abihail ahi hi.
Tuanu in amah tawh hih tapate a nei hi: Yeush, Shamaryah leh Zaham ahi hi.
Tuanu khit ciangin Rehoboam in Absalom’ tunu Maacah tenpih a, tuanu in amah tawh ta Abiyah, Attai, Ziza leh Shelomith a nei hi.
Rehoboam in a zi dangte leh a zineute khempeuh sangin Absalom’ tunu Maacah itzaw a, amah in zi sawm le giat leh, zineu sawmguk a nei hi. Hih a zite tawh amah in tapa 28 leh tanu 60 a nei hi.
Tua ciangin Rehoboam in ama za laih dingin Maacah’ tapa Abiyah min pia a, tua ahih ciangin amah kumpi a suahsak theih nadingin a sanggamte lakah tacil’ za a pia hi.

Amah pil gamtat-in, khuapi muanhuai peuhpeuh, Yahdah leh Benyamin gam sung khempeuh ah a tapate pawlkhat thehthangin, tua lai-ah amah in amaute aa dingin kicing takin sikin, amaute aa dingin zi tampi a zonsak hi.
Rehoboam ukna kipin amah a thahat ciangin, amah leh Israyl khempeuh in Yahweh’ Thukham nusia uh hi.
Amaute mawhin, Yahweh tungah gamta khial ahih manin Kumpi Rehoboam’ uk zawh a kum ngana kumin, Egypt kumpi Shishak in Yerusalem sim a,
sakolleeng 12,000, sakol tung tuangte leh sakol galkapte 60,000 tawh kuanin, Egypt panin amah a pawlpih: Lubim; Liby mite, Sukki mite leh Cushim; Ethiopia mite, sim zawh loh tawh a kuan hi.
Amah in Yahdah khuapi muanhuaite la-in, Yerusalem lamah a kuan uh hi.

Tua ciangin Shishak hangin Yerusalem ah a kituahkhawm Rehoboam leh Yahdah makaite kiangah kamsang Shemayah hong pai-in, amaute kiangah, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: ‘Note in kei nong nusia khin uh hi; tua ahih ciangin keimah in Shishak khut sungah kong nusiakhin hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl makaite leh kumpipa kiniamkhiatin, “Yahweh thumaan hi,” a ci uh hi.

Yahweh in amaute a kiniamkhiatna a muh ciangin, Shemayah kiangah Yahweh’ kammal hong tungin, ‘Amaute kiniamkhiat khin ahih manin amaute ka susia kei ding hi. Amaute ka suaktasak liailiai ding a, Shishak’ khut tawh Yerusalem tungah ka hehna ka sungkhia kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin amaute ama ukna nuai-ah om ding uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in Kei’ na a sepna leh hih minamte a uk kumpite’ na a sepna kikala kilamdanna tel ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Egypt kumpi Shishak in Yerusalem simin, tua ciangin amah in Yahweh’ Inn-a van manphate leh kumpi-inn-a van manphate a puakhia hi. Amah in bangmah a siit kei hi. Amah in Solomon bawlsa kham kidalna lumte zong a puakhia hi.
Kumpi Rehoboam in tuate tangin sumngo lumte bawlin, kumpi-inn lutna a cing dingin vaipuak a nei galkap bute khut sungah tuate a pia hi.
Yahweh’ Inn ah kumpipa a pai peuhpeuh ciangin, a cingte in lumte pua kawmin amah zui uh a, tua khit ciangin a kicing inndei ah tuate a apkik zel uh hi.
Amah a kiniamkhiat ciangin amah a kisuksiat kiuhkeuh loh na’ngin ama kiang panin Yahweh’ hehna kihei-in Yahdah sungah thupaizia zong a hoih hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Yerusalem ah Kumpi Rehoboam hong thakhauh-in a uk suak hi. Rehoboam kumpi a suahin amah kum 41 pha a, Yahweh in Ama Min a kipsak nadingin Israyl minam khempeuh panin a teelkhiat khuapi ahi Yerusalem ah amah in kum 17 a uk hi. A nu’ min pen Naamah hi a, Ammon mi ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amah a sia-in gamta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ deihna zon ding a lungsim ah a koih kei hi.

Rehoboam uk hun sunga thupiangte a pat panin a tawp dong kamsang Shemayah, leh khangthu ciaptehna a len thumupa Iddo’ laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam? Hih hun sung tawntungin Rehoboam leh Yeroboam kikalah kidona om den hi.
Tua hi a, Rehoboam a pate tawh ihmu-in David Khuapi ah a kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Abiyah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Kumpi Yeroboam’ uk zawh a kum sawm le kum giatna kumin Yahdah tungah Abiyah kumpi suak hi.
Amah in Yerusalem ah kum thum uk a, a nu’ min pen Maacah hi a, Gibeah mi Uriel’ tanu ahi hi. Abiyah leh Yeroboam kikalah galkidona om a,
galsim thei mi 400,000 tawh Abiyah gal sungah kuan a, Yeroboam in ama langah galsim thei mi 800,000 tawh a pang hi.
Tua ciangin Ephraim mualtung gama om Zemaraim Mual tungah Abiyah dingin, otsan a, “Yeroboam leh Israyl khempeuh, na ngai un!
Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa in David leh a suanlekhakte tungah Israyl tunga kumpi hihna tawntung thuciamna tawh a piaksa ahih lam thei lo na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Nebat’ tapa Yeroboam leh David’ tapa Solomon ulian khat bek dingto-in a ukpa a lehdo uh hi!
Rehoboam khangno-in tuahkhak nei nai lo a, amaute a nang ding zahin thahat lo ahih manin Solomon’ tapa Rehoboam langpan dingin Belial’ tapate, migina lote ama kiim ah kikhawm uh hi.

Tua hi a, tu-in David’ suante khut sunga om Yahweh’ kumpigam do dingin na geel uh hi! Note mi tampi na hi mah uh a, na pasiante (elohim) dingin Yeroboam bawlsa kham biaknatau a kualte zong no tawh a om hi!

Ahih hangin note in Levi mi Aaron suante ahi Yahweh’ siampite hawlkhia-in, minam dangte hihsa bang teekteekin na biakna thugente uh bawl hilo na hi uh hiam? Hong pai peuhpeuh in bawngtalno khat leh tuutal sagih tawh a ki-ap ding uh a, tua khit ciangin pasian (elohim) biakna thugen a suak hi!
Ahih hangin kote ahih leh, Yahweh pen ka Pa uh ahi hi! Amah ka nusia kei uh a, Yahweh tungah biaknasep a sem siampite pen Aaron’ suante ahi a, Levi mite in amau’ nasepna ah a huh uh hi!

Amaute in nitak sim leh zingsang sim Tamid hun sungin Yahweh tungah meihal biaknate pia-in leh paknamtuite a hal uh hi. Amaute in Kalsim Shabbat ni-in biaknazia-a a siang sabuai tungah ompihna anlum zong koih uh a, amaute in zan simin kham meivak khuam tunga meivakte a vak uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in Yahweh’ thupiakna a zui uh a, ahih hangin note in Amah a nusia uh hi!

En un, ko lamah Yahweh pang a, Ama’n hong makaih ding hi! Ama siampite in zaksakna peengkulte tawh note langah patauhna a gingsak dingin omkhin uh hi! Israyl’ tapate aw, i pate’ Pa Yahweh tawh kido kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh na gualzo kei ding uh hi!” a ci hi.
Tu-in Yeroboam in amau nunglam panin amaute a sim dingin a pangsimte a sawlkhin hi. Yeroboam in amaute mai-ah mun la-in, a pangsimte in amau nunglam ah mun a la hi.

Yahdah-te a khuadak uh ciangin, a nung leh a mai panin amaute a kido ding ahih lam theikhia uh hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh tungah amaute kiko uh hi. Siampite in amau peengkulte; chatsotserot, muut uh a,
tua ciangin Yahdah mite in galdona aw tawh a awng uh hi. Yahdah mite a galdona aw tawh a ot uh ciangin, Yahweh in Abiyah leh Yahdah-te mai-a Israyl khempeuh leh Yeroboam a sattuk hi.
Yahdah-te mai-ah Israyl mite a taikek uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in Yahdah-te khut sungah amaute a pia hi.
Abiyah leh a mite in amaute tungah supna lianpi tungsak a—gal sim thei Israyl mi 500,000 a kithatlum hi.
A pate’ uh Pa Yahweh tungah Yahdah mite kinga uh ahih manin amaute in gualzawhna ngah uh a, tua hunin Israyl mite a kiniambawl hi.
Abiyah in Yeroboam delhin, Beth-El khuapite tawh a kiima khuaneute, Yeshanah tawh a kiima khuaneute leh Ephron tawh a kiima khuaneute, ama kiang panin a matsak hi.
Abiyah uk hun sungin Yeroboam in vangliatna a ngahkik nawn kei hi. A tawpna ah Yahweh in Yeroboam satin, amah si hi.
Ahih hangin Abiyah vanglian semsem a, zi sawm le li tenpihin, tapa sawmnih le nih leh tanu sawm le guk a nei hi.
Tu-in Abiyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama lampite, leh ama gen thute, kamsang Iddo lai-atnate sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?

Tua hi a, Abiyah a pate tawh ihmu-in, tua ciangin amaute in David Khuapi ah amah a vui uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a tapa Asa in ama kumpi’ za luah a, ama uk hun sungin gam sungah kum sawm sung galdaihna om hi.
Yahweh mit ah a hoih a manin Asa gamta hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh amah in gamdang pasiante (elohim) biaknataute leh Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte hemkhia-in, a siangtho kuampite sukhamin, a siangtho khuamte a sattan hi;
tua ciangin Yahdah-te in a pate uh Pa Yahweh a zon nading leh Ama Thukhamte leh Ama Thupiaknate zui-in a sep nadingin thu a pia hi.
Amah in Yahdah khuapite khempeuh panin mun sangte leh paknamtui biaknataute hemkhia ahih manin ama nuai-ah kumpigam galdaihna a om hi.
Gam sung kinawngkaisakna omlo ahih manin amah in Yahdah gam sungah khuapi muanhuaite lam hi. Tua kumte sungin amah in galsim lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amah tawlngakna pia hi;

tua ahih ciangin amah in Yahdah-te kiangah, “Hih khuapite lamin, tuate a um dingin kulhpite, tausangte, kulhkongpite leh a kalhna zawlte bawl ni. Eite in Yahweh zong i hih manin leitang pen ei utdanin i hih thei hi. Eite in Amah i zong a, tua ciangin Amah in i kiimkot khempeuh panin galdaihna hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tuate lamin, a mavang uh hi.
Asa in Yahdah panin lum leh tei a tawi galkap 300,000 leh Benyamin panin lum leh thal a tawi mi 280,000 nei a, tuate khempeuh pen galhang vive ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a sim dingin galkap aw khat;1,000,000, leh sakolleeng 300, tawh Ethiopia mi Zerah hong kuanin, Mareshah ciang dong a tung hi.
Amah tawh kimu dingin Asa kuankhia a, Mareshah nai-a Zephathah Kuam sungah galkido dingin a kiging uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh a Pa tungah Asa kiko-in, “Yahweh aw, a thahatte langa a thanemte a huh Nang tawh a kibang Khat beek omlo hi! Kote hong huh in; Yahweh kote Pa aw; bang hang hiam cihleh kote in Nang kong muang uh a, Nangma Min tawh hih a honpi meimaite langah ka kuankhia uh hi. Yahweh aw, Nang pen kote Pa na hi hi! Nang langpanin mite zo theisak kei in!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Asa leh Yahdah-te mai-ah Ethiopia-te sattukin, Ethiopia-te a taikek uh hi.

Asa leh a mite in Gerar ciang dong amaute delh uh a, a kidamkik zo nawn lo Ethiopia-te tampitak a puk uh hi. Yahweh leh Ama galkapte mai-ah amaute kigawi a, Yahdah mite in van kinusia tampitak a puakhia uh hi.

Yahweh’ kitakhuaina amaute tungah om ahih manin amaute in Gerar kiima khuapi khempeuh susia uh a, galsimna pana a kisut van tampitak khuapite sungah om ahih manin amaute in tua khuapite khempeuh a luh uh hi.
Amaute in ganhon a neite zong do-in Yerusalem ah a ciahkik uh ciangin, tuu tampi leh kalaoh tampi a pua uh hi.
Obed’ tapa Azaryah tungah Yahweh’ Kha hong tungin,

Asa a dawn dingin amah a paikhia a, amah kiangah, “Asa, Yahdah leh Benyamin-te aw, ka thu ngai un! Note amah tawh na omlai tengun Yahweh in note hong ompih ding hi. Amah na zon uh leh, na mu ding uh hi! Ahih hangin Amah na taisan uh leh, Aman zong note hong taisan ding hi!
Bang hang hiam cihleh Israyl mite sauveipi a Man Pa leh Thukham; Torah, a hilh siampi lo tawh om uh hi.
Ahih hangin a lungkham uh ciangin Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh lamah amaute kihei uh a, Amah a zon uh ciangin a mu uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in a sungtum a pusuak mite aa dingin lungmuanna omlo a, tua gamte khempeuha a tengte lakah zong tawlngakna om tuan lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin minam khat in minam khat susia-in, khuapi khat in adang khat a susia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in lungkhamna nam khempeuh tawh amaute a buaisak hi.
Ahih hangin note na hih uh leh, thahat unla, na lung uh kiasak kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh na sep thaman na ngah ding uh hi!” a ci hi.

Kamsang Oded’ tapa Azaryah kiang panin hih kamsanna thute Asa in a zak ciangin, amah in tha hong ngahin, Yahdah leh Benyamin gam khempeuh pan leh Ephraim mualtung gam sunga a matsa khuapite panin kihhuai-in a huathuai pasiante (elohim) a hemkhia hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in Yahweh’ Inn lapkaihna mai-a om Yahweh’ biaknatau puahpha-in,

tua ciangin Yahdah leh Benyamin khempeuh leh amaute laka a teng Ephraim, Menasheh leh Simeon pana mite tawh zong a sam khawm hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh a Pa in amah a ompih lam amaute in a theih uh ciangin amaute tampitak in Israyl a taisan uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Asa uk zawh a kum sawm le kum ngana kum, a Kha Thumna Kha sungin Yerusalem ah amaute a kikhawm uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in amaute in van kinusia a puakkikte lak panin bawngtal 700 leh tuu 7,000 tawh Yahweh tungah biakna a pia uh hi.
Amaute in lungsim khempeuh leh a nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Yahweh, a pate uh Pa a zong nading leh,
Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa a zong lo mi peuhmah a moi a ham, numei pasal kisai loin a kithah nadingin thuciamna khat a nei uh hi.
Ngaihtaka kikona, lungdamin otna, peengkulte leh tuutal ki-te tawh Yahweh mai-ah amaute a kiciam uh hi.

Yahdah-te khempeuh tua kiciamna hangin a lungdam mahmah uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh kiciamin a nuntakna khempeuh tawh Amah zong khin uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in Amah mu-in, Yahweh in a kiimkot khempeuh ah galdaihna a pia hi.

Kumpi Asa in a pi Maacah nangawn kumpinu’ nu hihna panin hemkhia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuanu in a kihhuai a muhdah huai Asherah milim; A Siangtho Khuam, khat a bawl hi; Asa in tua khuam sattan a, gawigawpin, Yerusalem leh Olive mual kikala Kidron Kuam sungah a hal hi.
Amah in Israyl sung panin mun sangte a hepkhiatsiang kiuhkeuh loh hangin, Asa’ lungsim a nuntak sung tawntung Yahweh lamah paubaang lo hi.
Amah in a pa apsa nate leh ama apsa nate ahi: kham, ngun leh adang nazatte zong Yahweh’ Inn sungah a paipih hi.
Tua hi a, Asa uk zawh a kum sawmthum le ngana kum dong gal kidona a om nawn kei hi.
Asa uk zawh a kum sawmthum le gukna kumin Israyl kumpi Baasha in Yahdah simin, Yahdah kumpi Asa kiang panin kuamah paikhia thei loin, kuamah a lut theih loh nadingin limtakin dalin Ramah a lamto hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Asa in Yahweh’ Inn leh kumpi-inn van manpha koihnate panin ngun leh khamte lakhia-in, Damascus-a teng Aram kumpi Ben-Hadad kiangah tuate khakin a gen inah:

“Ka pa leh na pa bawl dan mahin kei leh nang kikalah thukimna khat bawl ni. En in, keimah in ngun leh khamte kong khak hi. Hong pai inla, kei kiang panin Israyl kumpipa Baasha a nungkik nadingin amah tawh na thukimna pel in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Asa tawh Ben-Hadad thukim a, Israyl khuapite ah a galkap bupa a sawl hi. Amaute in Iyon, Dan, Abel Maim, leh Naphtali’ vankholna khuapite khempeuh a sim uh hi.
Hih thu Baasha a kigen ciangin, Ramah a lamna khawlin, tua lai-a a nasepna a tawpsak hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Asa in Yahdah khempeuh thupia a, Baasha in Ramah lamna-a a zat suangte leh singte puakhia a, amah in Geba leh Mizpah lam nadingin tuate a zang hi.
Tua hun lai-in Yahdah kumpi Asa kiangah thumupa Hanani pai-in ama kiangah, “Aram kumpipa tungah kinga-in Yahweh na Pa tungah kinga lo na hih manin nangma khut panin Aram galkapte suakta uh hi!

Ethiopia-te leh Libya-te pen a sakolleengte leh a sakol tung tuangte tampitak tawh a om galkap honpi mang khat hilo ahi hiam? Tua hi napi-in Yahweh tungah kinga na hih manin Amah in nangma khut sungah amaute hong pia hi!

Bang hang hiam cihleh Ama lama a lungsim paubanna a omlo mite a thahatsak ding leh a panpih dingin Yahweh’ mit in leitung khempeuh a en kawikawi hi. Hih thu ah na hai gamtatzo a, tu-a kipanin nang tungah gal hong tung ding hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu hangin thumupa in Asa a hehsak a, tua ahih ciangin amah in thong sungah a lawn hi. Tua hun mahin Asa in a mite pawlkhat bawlsia-in a nengniam hi.
Asa uk hun sunga thupiangte a pat panin a tawp dong, Yahdah leh Israyl kumpite laibu sungah kiciamteh hi.
Ama uk zawh a kum sawmthum le kuana kumin, Asa a khe ah natna nei-in, a natna a nasia mahmah hi. Ahih hangin hih natna a neih sung nangawnin amah in Yahweh zong loin zato siamte kiang bek a zong hi.
Tua hi a, Asa a pate tawh ihmu-in ama uk zawh a kum sawmli le khatna kumin a si hi.

David Khuapi ah ama aa dingin amah ngiat bawlsa han ah amaute in amah a vui uh hi. Amaute in gimnamtui leh sathau laka kihel paknamtui tuamtuam tawh a kidim hankhuk ah sialin ama a zahtakna-in mei phual lianpi khat a cih uh hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa Yahshaphat in a kumpi’ za luahin, Israyl langpanin amahmah a kithakhauhsak hi.
Amah in Yahdah kulh nei khuapite khempeuh ah galkapte koih a, Yahdah gam sung leh a pa Asa matsa Ephraim khuapite sungah khuacingte a koih hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in Yahshaphat ompih hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a pa David’ lampite a zui hi. Amah in Baal zong loin,
a pate’ Pa Yahweh a zong hi. Amah in Ama Thukhamte zui-in, Israyl-te gamtat bangin a gamta kei hi;
tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in ama kumpigam ama khut sungah a kipsak hi. Yahdah khempeuh in Yahshaphat kiangah letsongte puak uh a, amah in neihlelam tampi leh pahtawina lianpi a ngah hi.
Ama lungtang pen Yahweh’ lampite ah kip mahmah ahih manin amah in Yahdah panin mun sangte leh Asherah khuampite a lakhia leuleu hi.
Ama uk zawh a kum thumna kumin Yahdah khuapite ah thuhilh dingin amah in a etteh huai ama uliante ahi: Obadyah, Zecharyah, Nethaneel, leh Micahyah-te a sawl hi.
Amaute tawh Levi mite: Shemayah, Nethanyah, Zebadyah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Yahnathan, Adoniyah, Tobiyah, Tobadoniyah; leh siampite: Elishama leh Yahram-te a paikhawm uh hi.
Amaute in Yahdah ah thuhilhin, Yahweh’ Thukham Laibu (Torah) a keng uh hi. Yahdah khuapite khempeuh ah amaute pai-in mite thu a hilh uh hi.
Yahdah gam tawh a kigamgi kumpigam khempeuh tungah Yahweh’ kihtakhuaina tung hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in Yahshaphat do ngam lo uh hi.
Philistia-te kimkhat in Yahshaphat kiangah letsongte leh ngun honpi khat puak uh hi. Arabia mite in zong ama kiangah ganhonte puak uh a—tuutal 7,700 leh keeltal 7,700 a puak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahshaphat a vangliatna khang semsem a, amah in Yahdah gam sungah khuapi muanhuaite leh vankholna khuapite a lam hi;
tua ciangin amah in Yahdah khuapite sungah panpihna neihsa tampi a khol venvan hi. Amah in Yerusalem ah galsiam mite zong a keem hi.
Amau beh tawh kizui-in amaute a phazah pen: Yahdah minam panin Yahdah gama a tultul ukte tunga galkap mangpa Adnah leh amah tawh a om galkap 300,000 ahi hi.
Ama zom ah Yahchanan leh galkap 280,000,
ama zom ah Yahweh tungah a kipianuam ngiat Zichri’ tapa Amasyah leh amah tawh a om galkap 200,000 ahi hi.
Benyamin minam panin: galhang ulian Elyada leh amah tawh a om thal leh lumte a tawi galkap 200,000,
ama nuai-ah Yahzabad leh amah tawh a om galsim dingin a kigingsa mi 180,000 ahi hi.
Hihte pen kumpipa in Yahdah gam sung khempeuh-a khuapi muanhuaite ah a koih mite banah, kumpipa nasemna-a omte ahi uh hi.
Tu-in Yahshaphat nakpi-in hau-in, pahtawina lianpi a ngah hi; ahih hangin amah in kitenna hangin Ahab tawh a kizom hi.
Kum tawm khat khit ciangin Samaria-a Ahab kiang a hawh dingin a paisuk hi. Amah leh a mite aa dingin Ahab in tuu leh bawngtal tampi go-in, amah tawh Ramoth Gilead a do khawm dingin a zol hi.

Israyl kumpi Ahab in Yahdah kumpi Yahshaphat kiangah, “Ramoth Gilead sim dingin kei tawh nong kuan ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Kei pen nang bang mah ka hi a, ka mite zong nangma mite bang mah ahi hi. Kote nang tawh gal sungah kong kuan khawm ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng hi;
Ahih hangin Yahshaphat in Israyl kumpipa kiangah, “Tuni-in Yahweh thu dong masa in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin Israyl kumpipa in kamsangte mihing 400 khawmin, amaute kiangah, “Ramoth Gilead sim dingin kuan ding ka hi hiam, ahih keileh omlai phot ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, “Paito in; bang hang hiam cihleh Pasian (El, Elohim) in kumpipa khut sungah hong pia ding hi!” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Yahshaphat in, “Yahweh kiang i dot theih nadingin hih lai-ah Yahweh’ kamsang khatpeuh omlo ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat dawngin, “Ama tungtawnin Yahweh kiang thu i dot theih nadingin mi khat bek omlai hi; ahih hangin amah ka mu dah hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in kei aa dingin a hoih thu khatpeuh kamsang ngei lo a, a sia lam vive ahi hi! Amah pen Micahyah hi a, Imlah’ tapa ahi hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Yahshaphat in, “Kumpipa in tua bang na cih ding kilawm lo hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in a uliante khat samin, “Tu mahmahin Imlah’ tapa Micahyah hong paipih in!” ci-in thu a pia hi.

Israyl kumpipa leh Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat in a puantualte uh silhin, amau kumpi-tokhom tuak ah a tu uh hi. Amaute pen Samaria kulh kongpi lutna kiang ancilna phual ah tu a, amaute mai-ah kamsang khempeuh in kam a sang uh hi.
Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekyah in ama aa dingin sik kite bawlin amah in, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Hih kite tawh amaute a siat matengin Aram mite na nawt ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
Kamsang khempeuh in zong tua mah bangin kamsang uh a, “Gilead ah paito inla, gualzo in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in kumpipa khut sungah hong pia ding hi!” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Micahyah sam dingin a kisawl kamtaipa in ama kiangah, “Tu-in ngai in. Kamsang dangte in mi khat thugen bangin kumpipa aa dingin a gualzawh ding thu gen uh hi. Amau thute tawh nangma thugen kituak sak inla, gualzawhna thu hong gen in!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Micahyah in, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin, ka Pa gen peuhpeuh, kei gen ding ahi pah hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa omna ah amah lut a, kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Micahyah aw, Ramoth Gilead sim ding i hi hiam, ahih keileh omlai phot ding i hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Kuan inla gualzo in, kumpipa’ khut sungah amaute hong kipia ding hi!” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Thudang gen loin Yahweh’ Min tawh a man thu nong gen nadingin bangzah vei hong kiciamsak ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amah in, “A cing omlo tuu bangin mualte tungah Israyl khempeuh a kithehthang ka mu hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, ‘Hihte in a uk ding nei lo uh hi. Hih mite khempeuh amau inn ciat ah lungnuamin ciah uh hen,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Amah in kei aa dingin a hoih thu kamsang ngei loin a sia bek kamsang hi, hong ci mah hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Micahyah in, “Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh’ kammal za in! Yahweh a kumpi-tokhom tungah a tu-in, ama kiimkot a vei leh a tak ah vantung mihonpite a ding, ka mu hi.
Yahweh in, ‘Ramoth Gilead ah amah a si dingin a kuantoh nadingin kua in amah zol ding ahi hiam?’ a ci hi. Khat in hih bangin genin, adang khat in tua bangin a gen hi.
Tua ciangin kha khat hong madawkin, Yahweh mai-ah ding a, ‘Keimah in ka zol ding hi!’ a ci hi. Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Bangci hih ding na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amah in dawngin, ‘Keimah kuankhia-in, a kamsangte khempeuh kam sungah kha zuau khatin ka va om ding hi,’ a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, ‘Amah na zolzo ding hi. Pai inla sem in!’ a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in en in! Yahweh in hih nangma kamsangte khempeuh kam sungah kha zuau khat koih khin a, tua ciangin Yahweh in nangma tungah thusia genzo hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Chenaanah’ tapa Zedekyah hong paito-in, Micahyah a paang bengin, “Yahweh kiang panin bang dan Kha nam in nang tungtawnin thu gen ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Micahyah in ama kiangah, “Man taktak hi, na inndei sungnungpen ah a kibu dingin na pai ni ciangin na thei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl kumpipa in, “Micahyah man unla, khuapi ukpa Amon kiang leh kumpipa’ tapa Yahash kiangah puakkik un!
Amaute kiangah: Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Lungnuamin kei kong ciahkik matengin hih pa thong sungah lawn unla, an tawm leh tui tawmtawm bek pia un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Micahyah in, “Lungnuamin nong ciahkik leh, Yahweh in kei tungtawnin thu a gen ngei lo hi ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “No mipi khempeuh in ka thugen ciamteh un!” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ramoth Gilead ah Israyl kumpipa leh Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat a kuanto uh hi.

Israyl kumpipa in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Keimah in ka meel selin gal sungah ka pai ding a, ahi zongin nangmah in na puantualpi silh in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israyl kumpipa in a meel selin gal sungah a pai uh hi.
Tu-in Aram kumpipa in a sakolleeng ukte kiangah thupia-in, “Israyl kumpipa lo buang a neu ahi a, a lian ahi zongin kuamah do kei un—amah bek do un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a sakolleeng ukte in Yahshaphat a muh uh ciangin amaute in, “Hihpa pen Israyl kumpipa hi taktak ding hi,” ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. A do dingin amah umcih uh hi; ahih hangin Yahshaphat a kikokhia-in, tua ciangin Yahweh in amah huh hi—Yahweh in ama kiang panin amaute a nungkik nadingin amaute a khin hi.
Sakolleeng ukte in amah pen Israyl kumpipa a hih loh lam a thei uh ciangin, a nungdelhna uh panin a kiheikhia uh hi.

Ahih hangin mi khat in a thatang neih khempeuh tawh a thal mawklot a, a thaltang in a kidalnate kikal panin Israyl kumpipa a kha hi. Amah in a sakolleeng hawlpa thupia-in, “Kihei in! Kei liam ka hih manin kidona sung panin hong paikhiatpih in!” a ci hi.
Sun tawntung nasia takin gal kido a, Aram mite lam nga-in a sakolleeng tungah nitak dong kumpipa a kingam a, nitum hun pawl ciangin amah si hi.
Ahih hangin Yahdah kumpi Yahshaphat pen Yerusalem-a ama inn ah lungmuang takin a tungkik hi.
Amah tawh kimu dingin Hanani’ tapa thumupa Yahu pai-in Kumpi Yahshaphat kiangah, “Migilo-te huhin Yahweh a mudahte it ding na hi hiam? Hih thu hangin Yahweh’ hehna nang tungah hong tung hi!
Ahi zongin nang sungah thumaanna pawlkhat om hi; tua in Asheroth hemkhia-in Yahweh zong dingin na lungsim na khensatkhitna thu ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua hi a, Yerusalem ah Yahshaphat teng a, Beersheba panin Ephraim mualtung gam ciang dong mite lakah amah a paikhia leuleu hi; tua ciangin Yahweh a pate uh Pa kiangah amaute a kiheikiksak hi.
Amah in Yahdah khuapi muanhuaite khempeuh, gam sung teng ah thukhente zong seh a,

tua ciangin amah in hih thukhente thu hilhin, “Bang hih na hi uh hiam, cih limtakin ngaihsun un; bang hang hiam cihleh note in mi khat aa dingin thukhen na hi kei uh a, thukhenna ah note tawh hong om Yahweh aa ding thukhen na hi uh hi.

Tu-in Yahweh’ zahtakhuaina no tungah hong om tahen! Na sepna uhah kidawm un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh eite Pa’ sungah thumaan lohna ahi a, mi deidanna ahi a, sumgolh lakna ahi zongin om lo hi,” a ci hi.

Yahshaphat in Yerusalem ah zong Yahweh’ Thukham a zuisak ding leh kitotnate a vengsak dingin Levi-te pawlkhat, siampite leh Israyl makai ukpite pawlkhat a seh hi. Amaute zong Yerusalem ah a teng uh hi.
Amah in amaute thupia-in, “Note in Yahweh zahtakna tawh lungsim paubanna om loin citak takin na nasepte uh na sem hamtang ding uh hi.

Khuapite sunga teng na sanggamte kiang panin thu khat peuhpeuh note mai-ah hong tun ciang; Thukham ahih keileh thupiak, ngeina kipte ahih keileh biakna ngeinakipte langpanin sisan kisuahna ahi a, lehdona tampite ah, Yahweh tungah a khialh loh nadingin amaute na vauhilh ding uh hi; tua bang hi keileh, Ama hehna note tungah hong tung ding a, na sanggampa tungah zong a tung ding hi. Ahi zongin note in amaute na vauhilh uh leh, note a khiallo na hi ding uh hi.

Yahweh tawh kisai nate khempeuh ah note tungah Siampi Lian Amaryah a om lam leh, kumpipa tawh kisai nate khempeuh ah note tungah Yahdah innkuan tunga ukpipa Ishamael’ tapa Zebadyah a om lam, phawk un; tua hi a, Levi mite in note’ ulian-in na sem ding uh hi. Note in nakpi-in hangsanna tawh thukhen unla, mawhbaanglo mite lamah Yahweh om tahen!” a ci hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Yahshaphat a sim dingin Ammon mite leh Meunnin mite pawlkhat tawh Moab mite a kuan uh hi.

Mi pawlkhat hong pai-in Yahshaphat kiangah, “Nang hong sim dingin Edom pan leh Tuipi Si galkhat panin galkap tampitak hong kuan uh hi. En in, Hazazon-Tamar (tua pen En Gedi) ah om uh hi,” ci-in a ko uh hi.
Hih thu ah Yahshaphat patau a, tua ciangin amah in Yahweh zon ding a khensat hi. Amah in Yahdah gam sung khempeuh ah an tan ding thu zasakin,
tua ciangin Yahweh kiang thu a dong dingin Yahdah-te kikhawm uh hi—Yahdah khuapite khempeuh panin Yahweh zong dingin amaute a pai uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ Inn huang sung inntual thak mai ah Yahdah leh Yerusalem pana mipite kikhopna ah Yahshaphat dingto-in a gen inah:

“Yahweh, ka pate uh Pa aw, vantunga kote Pa hilo na hi hiam? Minamte’ kumpigam khempeuh tungah a ukpa hilo na hi hiam? Kuamah in nang hong nan zawh loh na dingin na khut sungah vangliatna leh thahatna om hilo ahi hiam?
Na mi Israyl mai panin hih gama tengte hawlkhia-in, Nangma lawm Abraham’ suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin a pia kote Pa hilo na hi hiam?
Tua sungah amaute tengin, Nangma Min aa dingin tua sungah munsiangtho khat lamin,

“Namsau ahi a, thukhenna ahi a, pulnatna ahi a, kialpi ahi zongin kote tungah siatna hong tun ciangin, hih Inn mai leh Nang omna ah (bang hang hiam cihleh Nangma Min hih inn sungah om hi) kote dingin, lungkhamna tawh nang tungah kong kiko uh ciangin, kote hong za inla hong huh in.

Ahih hangin tu-in, Egypt panin Israyl-te a paikhiat lai-in amaute gam sim dingin phal loin amau kiang panin Israyl-te kihei-in amaute a suksiat loh mite ahi Ammon, Moab leh Seir Mual pana mite hih lai-ah om uh hi.
Nangmah in kote luah dingin nong piak Nangma neihsa panin kote hong lawnkhia dingin hong pai-in kote hong thukkik dingin amaute hiah om uh hi!

Kote Pa aw, amaute thu khen lo ding na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cihleh kote do dingin hong kuan sim zawh loh-a tam mi honpite langah kote in thahatna bangmah ka nei kei uh a, ka cih nading uh thei loin nangmah kong mitsuan uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in a zite, a tate leh a naupangnote uh zong a kihelin Yahdah khempeuh, Yahweh mai-ah a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi honte lakah a din laitakin Asaph suan Levi mi Yachaziel tungah Yahweh’ Kha hong tung hi; amah pen Zecharyah, Benayah’ tapa, Yeiel’ tapa, Mattanyah’ tapa ahi hi;

tua ciangin amah in, “Ngai un, Yahdah gam leh Yerusalem gam sunga a teng khempeuh aw! Ngai in, Kumpi Yahshaphat aw! Yahweh in note tungah hih bangin ci hi: Hih mihon tampite hangin lau kei unla, lungkia kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh galsimna pen no aa hi lo hi! Yahweh aa ahi hi!
Zingciangin amaute a sim dingin kuansuk un. Ziz kahtohna tawnin amaute hong paito ding uh a, Yeruel Sehnel gam lam kuam mong ah amaute na mu ding uh hi.

Yahdah leh Yerusalem aw, hih galsimna ah note do ding kisam lo hi, ahih hangin mun la-in, kiptakin ding unla, note hong ompih Yahweh’ hotkhiatna en un! Lau kei unla, zong lungkia kei un! Zingciangin amaute a sim dingin kuankhia un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in note hong ompih ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshaphat in a maitang leilam ngatin a lu kunsuk a, tua ciangin Yahdah leh Yerusalem-a teng khempeuh zong Yahweh bia dingin Yahweh mai-ah a kun uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kohath suante leh Korah suante lak panin Levi mi pawlkhat dingto-in, aw ngaih mahmah tawh Israyl’ Pa Yahweh a phat uh hi.

Zingsangin amaute thobaihin, Tekoa Sehnel gam sungah a pai dingin a kithawi uh hi. Amaute a paikhiat laitak un, Yahshaphat dingto-in, “Yahdah leh Yerusalem mite aw, na ngai un! Yahweh note Pa um un; note hong kikipsak ding hi! Ama kamsangte um un; na gualzo ding uh hi!” a ci hi.

Mite tawh thu kikupna a neih khit ciangin Yahweh’ kipsak puan siangthote silhin, “HalleluYahweh! Yahweh tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cihleh ama itna kip tawntung hi,” ci-in lasa-in galkapte mai-ah a pai ding mi a seh hi.
Yahweh’ phatnate sak ding a kipat uh ciangin, Yahdah sim dingin a kuan Ammon, Moab leh Seir pana mite a buksim ding Yahweh in koih a, amaute a kizo hi.

Amaute a that siang ding leh amaute a susia dingin Ammon leh Moab mite in Seir Mual pana mite do ding kipan uh hi. Tua khit ciangin amaute in Seir-a tengte a beisak khit uh ciangin amaute khatlekhat suksiat ding a kipan uh hi.
Sehnel gam a kigalmuhna mun ah Yahdah-te a tunin, mi honpite lam a et uh ciangin leilaka puksa misi luangte bek a mu uh hi. Kuamah suakta lo uh hi.

Van kinusiate a la dingin Yahshaphat leh a mite a pai uh ciangin amaute in bawngte, galvante, puansilhte, leh a tam man nazatte, sim zawhzah khengin tampi mu uh a, tuate amau aa dingin a la uh hi. Ni khat sungin a puak uh amau sim zawhzah sangin tamzaw hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in ni thum sung van kinusiate a khawm uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate tamlua mahmah hi.
A ni lina ni ciangin amaute in Berachah Kuam ah khol uh a, tua lai-ah amaute in Yahweh a phat uh hi. Tua mun min pen tuni dongin Berachah Kuampi a kici hi.
Yahshaphat makaihna tawh, Yahdah leh Yerusalem-a mi khempeuh in amah zui-in Yerusalem ah lungdamin ciahkik uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in a galte uh tungah amaute a lungdamsak hi.
Yerusalem-a Yahweh’ Inn ah harp khausaite, zither khausaite leh peengkulte tawh amaute tung uh hi;
Yahweh in Israyl galte a dosakna thu a zak uh ciangun kumpigamte khempeuh tungah Yahweh’ lauhuaina a tung hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshaphat in lungnuam takin uk hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a Pa in ama gamgi khempeuh panin tawlngakna a pia hi.
Yahshaphat pen Yahdah tungah kumpi ahi hi. Amah kumpi a suahin kum sawmthum le nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnih le kum nga uk hi. A nu’ min pen Azubah hi a, Shilhi’ tanu ahi hi.
Amah in a pa Asa’ lampi zui a, Yahweh mit ah a manin gamta-in a pialkhia kei hi.
Ahi zongin mun sangte kihemkhia lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a pate uh Pa, Yahweh tungah mite in a lungsim nga lo uh hi.
Tu-in Yahshaphat uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite a pat panin a tawp dong, Israyl kumpite laibu sungah a kiciamteh Hanani’ tapa Yahu’ laibu sungah kigelh taktak hi.
Tua thu khit ciangin Yahdah kumpi Yahshaphat in gitlohna a gamta Israyl kumpipa Ahazyah tawh kipawlna khat a bawl hi.
Tarshish a pai ding teembawte lam dingin amah tawh a kipawl uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Ezion Geber ah teembawte a lam uh hi.

Ahih hangin Mareshah-a Dodayah’ tapa Eliezer in Yahshaphat langah kamsangin, “Ahazyah tawh kipawl na hih manin, Yahweh in na bawlsate susia ding hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin teembawte kisia-in, tua ciangin Tarshish ah amaute a pai thei kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahshaphat a pate tawh ihmu-in, David Khuapi ah a pate tawh a kivui khawm hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Yahram in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahshaphat tapate ahi a sanggam pasalte pen: Azaryah, Yehiel, Zecharyah, Azaryah, Michael, leh Shephatyah hi a—amaute khempeuh Yahdah kumpipa Yahshaphat tapate ahi hi.

A pa un amaute tungah letsong lianpi pia hi: ngun, kham leh, adang a manphate leh Yahdah gam sunga khuapi muanhuaite pia a, ahih hangin amah in kumpigam pen Yahram tungah pia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen a tapa upapen ahi hi.
Ahih hangin kumpigam tungah Yahram a kikipsak khit ciangin amah in namsau tawh a sanggamte khempeuh leh Israyl uliante pawlkhat a that hi.
Yahram kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmthum le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum giat uk hi.
Ahab innkuan gamtat bang teekteekin Israyl kumpite lampi amah in zui hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a zi pen Ahab’ tanu hi a, Yahweh mit ah a sia-in a gamta hi.
Tua hi napi-in Yahweh in David leh a suanlekhak tungah a tawntungin meivak khat pia dingin ciamkhin ahih nungsangin Amah in David tawh a thuciamna hangin David innkuan a susia kei hi.
Ama uk hun sungin Edom mite in Yahdah’ thuneihna lehdo-in, amau tungah kumpi khat a bawl uh hi;
Tua ahih ciangin Yahram zong a uliante leh a sakolleengte tawh amaute sim dingin a kuan hi. Edom mite in amah leh a sakolleeng uliante umcih a, ahih hangin amah dingto a, zan hun sungin a phutlet hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Edom mite in Yahdah’ thuneihna a lehdo lai uh hi. Tua hun lai-in Libnah in a ukpa leh do hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahweh a pate uh Pa a nusia hi.
Amah in zong Yahdah mualtungte ah mun sangte lamin, pasiante (elohim) tunga paktatna ah Yerusalem mite makaihin, Yahdah mite a lampialsak hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang Yliyah kiang panin ama tungah laikhak khat tung a, “Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: na pa Yahshaphat lampite ahi a, Yahdah kumpi Asa lampite ahi zongin zui loin,

Israyl kumpite lampi zui-in, Ahab innkuan paktatna bang lianin Yahdah-te leh Yerusalem mite pasiante (elohim) tungah na paktatsakna hang leh, nang sangin a hoihzaw na pa’ innkuanpihte mahmah ahi na sanggamte zong na thahna hangin,
en in, Yahweh in gimna lianpi khat tawh na mite, na tapate, na zite leh nang aa khempeuh vat ding hi—
tua ciangin na natna in na gilzangte a tolhkhiatsak dongin gilsung natna sauveipi khat tawh na ci a na pha mahmah ding hi, ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Ethiopia-te nai-a a teng Philistia-te leh Arab-te tawh Yahram a kigalneihsak hi.
Amaute in Yahdah simin, luh a, kumpi-inn sunga om neihsate khempeuh tawh a tapate leh a zite a puakhiatsak uh hi. A tapa naupen Yahachaz lobuang a tapate khat beek a kinusia a om kei hi.
Hih thu khempeuh khit ciangin Yahweh in a dam thei lo natna khat tawh a gilsung a vat hi.

A hun a cin hun, kum nih bei khit ciangin a natna hangin a gilzangte tolhkhia-in, nakpi-in nasakna tawh a si hi. A pate aa dingin vui bawlna mei ahih bangun a mite in ama aa dingin vui bawlna mei a cihsak kei uh hi.
Amah kumpi a suahin kum sawmthum le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum giat uk hi. Amah si a, kuamah dah loin David Khuapi ah a kivui hi; ahih hangin kumpite hante sungah a kivui kei hi.

Tua ciangin Yerusalem mite in Yahram’ tapa neupen Ahazyah, ama mun ah kumpi-in bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh giahphual simin Arab-te tawh hong pai a buluh mite in a tapa upate khempeuh that khin uh hi. Tua thu hangin Yahdah kumpi Yahram’ tapa Ahazyah kumpi a suak ahi hi.

Amah in Yerusalem-a tausangte tung leh kulh kiute ah thaltangte leh suangtum golpite a lawn thei khutsiamte geelsa sette a lam hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama minthanna a gamla a nai ah a kizel hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah a vangliat dongin nakpi takin a kihuh hi.

Siampi Lian Azaryah leh Yahweh’ siampi a hangsan mi sawmgiat ama nungah a pai hi.

Amaute in Kumpi Uzziyah maingatin ama kiangah, “Yahweh tungah paknamtui hal dingin nang aa dingin phalna om lo hi. Paknamtui hal dingin a ki-apsa Aaron’ suan siampite bek in paknamtui hal ding uh hi. Khial khin na hih manin munsiangtho panin taikhia in! Yahweh i Pa kiang panin pahtawina na ngah kei ding hi!” a ci uh hi.

Siampi Lian Azaryah leh adang siampite khempeuh in amah a et uh ciangin, ama taltang tungah phaknatna a om lam a mu uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in manlang takin tua mun panin a paipihkhia uh hi. Yahweh in amah sat ahih manin amahmah zong a paikhia nuam pah hi.

Kumpi Uzziyah a sih dongin a phak hi. Amah phakin Yahweh’ Inn panin a kihemkhia ahih manin amah hoih takin a kikhoina inn sungah a teng hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa’ tapa Yahtham in kumpi-inn sung ukin, gam sung mite thu a khen hi.
Tu-in Uzziyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite a pat panin a tawp dong Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah in a gelh hi.

Tua ciangin Uzziyah a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in kumpite neihsa han leitang ah a tapate tawh a vui khawm uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mite in, “Amah a phak hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Yahtham in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Yahtham kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih le kum nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawm le kum guk uk hi. A nu’ min pen Yerushah hi a, Zadok’ tanu ah hi.
A pa Uzziyah (Azaryah) gamtat mah bangin Yahweh mit ah amah a manin gamta hi; ahih hangin a pa bang loin, Yahweh’ Inn sungah amah a lut kei hi. Ahih hangin mite in a sia gamtatnate zui lai uh hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ Inn Kongpi Tungnung lam a, Ophel kulh tung zong zaitakin a lam hi.
Amah in Yahdah mualtungte ah zong khuapite lam a, gammang tulak ah zong amah in mun muanhuaite leh tausangte a lam hi.

Amah in Ammon mite’ kumpipa simin amaute a zo hi. Tua kumin Ammon mite in ama kiangah siahin ngun talent 100; mangbuh kor 1000, mangbuh-ham kor 10,000 a puak uh hi. Ammon mite in a kum nihna leh a kum thumna kumin zong hih zah mah a pia uh hi.
Yahweh a Pa mai-ah amah in Yahweh’ lampite kiptakin zui ahih manin Yahtham a vanglian hi.
Yahtham uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama galdonate leh a hanciamnate, Israyl leh Yahdah kumpite laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Amah kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le kum nga pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawm le kum guk a uk hi.
Tua ciangin Yahtham a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in David Khuapi ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Ahaz in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Ahaz kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawm le kum guk a uk hi; ahih hangin a pa David gamtat bangin amah Yahweh mit ah a manin gamta lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Israyl kumpite lampite zui-in, Baal-te a biak theih nadingin a kisung milimte a bawl hi.
Amah in Ben Hinnom Kuam ah paknamtui halin, Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a notkhiat minamte kihhuainate tawh kizui-in amah in a tate mei sungah biakna-in a pia hi.
Amah in mun sangte tung, mual dawnte leh singniim nuai peuhpeuh ah biakpiakna pia-in paknamtui a hal hi.

Hih thute hangin Yahweh a pa in Aram kumpite khut sungah amah a pia hi. Amaute in amah zo a, van kinusia tampitak la-in, Damascus ah tuate a paipih uh hi. Amah nakpitakin bawlsia-in a nasak Israyl kumpipa khut sungah amah a kipuak hi.
Remalyah’ tapa Pekah in ni khat thu-in Yahdah sungah mi 120,000 that a, tuate khempeuh galsiam vive ahi uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Yahweh, a pate uh Pa a nusia uh hi.
Ephraim mi a thahat galkap Zichri in kumpipa’ tapa Masseyah, kumpipa-inn a uk ulian Azrikam leh kumpipa zoma a thunei Elkanah a that hi.
Israyl mite in tuate kinaipih sung panin a zite, a tapate leh a tanute uh mi 200,000 salin a man uh hi. Amaute in van tampitak zong man uh a, Samaria ah tuate a pua uh hi.

Ahih hangin tua mun ah Yahweh kamsang khat om a, a min pen Oded ahi hi. Samaria ah a tungkhin deuh galkapte mai-ah amah pai-in amaute kiangah, “Yahdah-te tungah na pate uh Pa Yahweh heh ahih manin Amah in note khut sungah amaute hong pia hi. Ahih hangin note in heh mahmahna tawh amaute na that uh a, tua in vantung dong ban hi.
Tu-in na sila numei na sila pasal dingin Yahdah mite leh Israyl mite na bawl sawm uh hi; ahih hangin Yahweh na Pa uh mai-ah note mahmah in zong mawhna nei lo na hi uh hiam?
Tu-in ka thugen ngai unla, na sanggamte kiang panin na lak uh galmatte ciahkiksak un; tua bang ahih keileh, Yahweh’ heh mahmahna note tungah hong tung ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Ephraim mite’ ukpi pawlkhat, Yahchanan’ tapa Azaryah, Meshillemoth’ tapa Berechyah, Shallum’ tapa Yechizkiyah leh Hadlai’ tapa Amasa-te in gal kidona panin hong ciah mite na maitang sik uh a,

amaute kiangah, “Galmatte hih lai-ah nong paipih kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh tungah eite i khialkhin zo hi. I mawhnate in Israyl tungah nakpi-a hehna a tun dingin kicing khinzo na pi-in note in na mawhnate uh leh na khialhnate uh khansak sawm lai uh hi!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galhiam tawi mite in galkap bute leh mihonpi mai panin galmatte leh vanmatte a nusia uh hi.

Tua ciangin a mina kilo mite in galmatte la-in,vanmatte panin puan la-in a guaktanga om khempeuh puan a silhsak uh hi. Amaute in puansilhte leh khedapte, an leh tuite pia-in sathau tawh amaute a zut uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in a thazawmte khempeuh laate tungah tuangsak uh hi. Amaute in nisuh khuapi ahi Yericho-a a sanggamte kiangah puak uh a, tua khit ciangin Samaria ah amaute ciahkik uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in kumpi Ahaz in Assyria kumpite kiangah huhna ngen hi;
Bang hang hiam cihleh Edom mite kuan leuleu-in Yahdah sim uh a, galmatin kaikhia uh hi.

Philistia-te in zong Shephelah; mualbul, khuapite, leh Yahdah gama Negev buluh-in, Beth Shemesh, Aiyalon, Gederoth, Sochoh leh a kiima om khuaneute, Timnah leh a kiima om khuaneute, leh Gimzo leh a kiima om khuaneute manin, tua lai-ah a teng uh hi.
Israyl kumpipa Ahaz hangin Yahweh in Yahdah-te nuainet hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Yahdah gam sungah gitlohna khangsakin Yahweh tungah citak loh den keeina hang ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amah langah Assyria kumpipa Tiglath Pileser kuanto-in amah a panpih ding cih loh a nuainetzaw lai hi.
Ahaz in Yahweh Inn pan hitaleh kumpi-inn pan hitaleh mipi makaite kiang pan hitaleh van pawlkhat la-in, tuate Assyria kumpipa tungah a pia hi; ahih hangin tua in amah a huh zo tuan kei hi.
Hih buaina hun sung teekteek mahin Yahweh tungah amah a citak kei semsem zawsop lai hi! Tua in Kumpi Ahaz ahi hi!

Amah in amah a zo Damascus-te’ pasiante (elohim) tungah biakpiaknate pia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a lungsim sungah, “Aram kumpite pasiante (elohim) in amaute uh ahih manin kei zong tuate tungah biakpiakna pia leng, amaute in kei hong huh thei kha ding uh hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin amaute pen ama pukna leh Israyl khempeuh pukna a suak hi.
Ahaz in Yahweh’ Inn-a vanzatte kaikhawmin, a satzan mang hi. Amah in Yahweh’ Inn kongkhakte khakcipin, ama aa dingin Yerusalem kiu khempeuh ah biaknataute a bawl hi.
Yahdah khuapite khempeuh ah amah in a kikham pasiante (elohim) tungah biakpiaknate a hal nadingin Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte lamin, Yahweh, a pate Pa a hehsak hi.
Tu-in ama uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, ama lampite khempeuh a pat panin a tawp dong Yahdah leh Israyl kumpite laibu sungah kigelh taktak hi.

Tua hi a, Ahaz a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in Yerusalem gam sunga khuapi khat ah a vui uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in Israyl kumpite han sungah a koih kei uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Hezekyah in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Hezekyah kum sawmih le kum nga a phak ciangin amah kumpi suak a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnih le kum kua uk hi. A nu’ min pen Abiyah hi a, Zecharyah’ tanu ahi hi.
A pa David hihsa bangin Yahweh mit ah amah a manin gamta hi.
A ma uk a kum masa, Kha Masa sungin, amah in Yahweh’ Inn kongkhakte hongin, tuate a puahpha hi.
Amah in siampite leh Levi-te paipihin, nisuahna lampanga mun awng ah amaute khawm a,
amaute kiangah, “Levi-te aw na ngai un! Tu-in no le no ki-ap unla kisiansuah un, tua ciangin a pate uh Pa Yahweh’ Inn ap-in siansuah unla, munsiangtho panin a sianglote leh a ninte hemkhia un.
I pate in thupalsatin, citak loin, Yahweh i Pa mit ah a sia-in gamta khin uh hi. Amaute in Amah taisanin, Yahweh tenna mun panin a maitangte uh heikhia khin uh a, Amah a nungngatsan uh hi.
Amaute in innmai liim kongkhakte zong khakcipin, meivakte a sumit uh hi. Amaute in paknamtui hal lo uh a, Israyl’ Pa Yahweh’ munsiangtho ah meihal biaknate zong pia lo uh hi.
Hih thute hangin Yahweh’ hehna Yahdah tung leh Yerusalem tunga tung a, tu-in note mit mahmah tawh na muh mah bangun Amah in amaute a kihtakhuai cikzethuai, leh a dipkuathuai-in a bawl hi.
Hih hangin i pate namsau tawh pukin, i tapate, i tanute i zite galmatin a om uh hi.
Tu-in eite kiang panin ama hehna a kiheikhiat theih nading Israyl’ Pa Yahweh tawh thuciamna khat bawl ding ka lungsim sungah om hi.

Ka tate aw, tu-in thusim loin om kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in ama mai-ah a ding ding, ama na a sem ding, ama mai-ah biaknasep a sem ding leh paknamtui a hal dingin note hong teelzo hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Levi-te dingto uh a, Kohath gui panin Amasai’ tapa Mahath leh Azaryah’ tapa Yahyal ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin Merari’ gui panin Abdi’ tapa Kish leh Yehallelel’ tapa Azaryah ahi hi. Gershon’ gui panin Zimmah’ tapa Yahach leh Yahach’ tapa Eden ahi hi.
Elizaphan’ suante panin Shimri leh Yeiel ahi hi. Asaph’ suante panin Zecharyah leh Mattanyah ahi hi.
Heman’ suante panin Yehiel leh Shimei hi a, Yeduthun’ suante panin Shemayah leh Uzziel ahi hi.
Amaute in a sanggamte khawmin, amau le amau ki-apin kisiansuah uh a, Yahweh’ Inn a hah ding leh a siansuah dingin a lut uh hi.

A hah ding leh a siansuah dingin Yahweh’ Inn a sungnung lamah siampite a lut uh hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn sunga om a nin khempeuh Yahweh’ Inn tual ah a pusuah uh hi; tua khit ciangin Levi-te in puakhia-in, Kidron Kuam ah a paai uh hi.

Kha Masa kha, a ni masa ni-in siansuah ding kipan uh a, tua kha a ni giat ni-in Yahweh’ Inn mai lapkaihna dong tun uh hi; tua ahih ciangin ni giat sungin amaute in Yahweh’ Inn apin siansuah uh a, Kha Masa kha, a ni sawm le ni guk ni-in a zo siang uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin kumpi Hezekyah kiangah amaute pai-in, “Yahweh’ Inn buppi, meihal biaknatau leh amah tawh kisai nazatte khempeuh, ompihna anlum aa dingin sabuai leh amah tawh kisai nazatte khempeuh ka hahsiang khin uh hi.
Kumpi Ahaz in ama kumpi sep sungin a thupalsatna tawh a hepkhiat nazatte khempeuh puahpha-in ka ap khin uh a, tu-in Yahweh’ biaknatau mai-ah tuate a om hi,” a ci hi.
A zingciang zingsangin kumpi Hezekyah thobaih-in, khuapi ukte khawmin Yahweh’ Inn ah a paito uh hi.

Amaute in kumpigam aa ding, munsiangtho aa ding leh Yahdah-te aa dingin mawhna hanga biakna dingin keeltal leh, bawngtal sagih, tuutal sagih, tuuno apa sagih a keng uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Yahweh’ biaknatau tungah tuate a pia dingin Aaron’ suan siampite a sawl hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in bawngtalte go uh a, siampite in a sisante la-in, biaknatau lamah a theh uh hi. Amaute in tuutalte go-in biaknatau lamah a sisante a theh uh hi. Amaute in tuunote zong go-in biaknatau lamah a sisante a theh uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute in kumpipa leh mihonte mai-ah mawhna hanga biakna keeltalte paipihin, amaute in tua keelte tungah a khutte a nga uh hi.

Mihonte paipih meihal biakna a phazah pen: bawngtal 70, tuutal 100 leh tuuno apa 200—hihte khempeuh Yahweh tungah meihal biakna-in a kipia hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in mite aa dingin a bawlsak thute hangin Hezekyah leh mite khempeuh a lungnuam mahmah uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh thupiangte manglang takin kizo hi.

Yerusalem sung Yahweh’ Inn ah amaute hong pai nading uh leh Israyl’ Pa Yahweh tungah Paisan pawi a bawl dingin Hezekyah in Yahdah leh Israyl khempeuh tungah thu puakin, Ephraim leh Menasheh tungah zong lai a khak hi;
bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa, a uliante leh Yerusalem-a mihon khempeuh in a Kha Nihna kha sungin Paisan pawi a bawl dingin thukim uh hi.
Tu-in siampite mi a kicingzah ding amau ki-apin kisiansuah nai lo uh a, mite zong Yerusalem ah kikhawm nai lo uh ahih manin a hun Kha Masa kha sungin a bawl thei kei uh hi.
Hih khensatna pen kumpipa leh mihon khempeuh aa dingin a hoih tawh kibang hi;

tua ahih ciangin amaute in Beersheba panin Dan dong Israyl sung khempeuh ah tangkona khat nei-in, Yerusalem ah Israyl’ Pa Yahweh tungah Paisan pawi bawl dingin hong pai nadingun a sam hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a kigelhsa tawh kizui-in amaute in Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a bawl loh uh sauveipi ahi hi.

Kumpipa leh a uliante kiang pana laikhakte pua kawmin Israyl khempeuh leh Yahdah sung buppi ah kamtaite pai-in, tua laite sungah: “Israyl mite aw, Abraham, Isaac leh Israyl’ Pa Yahweh tungah ciahkik un. Tua ciangin Assyria kumpite khut sung panin a suakta a omlaisun note lamah Amah hong paikik ding hi.
Note in na muh mah bangun, siatna ah amaute a puak i pate’ Pa Yahweh tungah khialhin thu a palsat na pate uh leh na sanggamte uh bangin om kei un.
