Yahweh lamah na ciahkik uh leh, galmatin a kaikhia mite in na sanggamte leh na tate uh hehpih ding uh a, hih gam ah a ciahkik ding phal ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa pen migi-in hehpihna nei hi. Ama kiangah na ciahkik uh leh Amah in note kiang panin a mai heikhia lo ding hi,” ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ephraim leh Menasheh gam sung khempeuh, Zebulun ciang dong khua khat panin khua khat kamtaite pai uh hi; ahih hangin mite in amaute nuihsanin a zahpih uh hi.
Ahi zongin Asher, Menasheh leh Zebulun panin pawlkhat amau mahmah kiniamkhiatin Yerusalem ah a pai uh hi.
Yahweh’ Thukham a zui kumpipa leh a uliante thupiakna a mangin mite lungsim kipumkhatna a pia dingin Yahweh’ khut in Yahdah tungah na a sem hi.
Kha Nihna kha sungin Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a mang dingin mihon tampi tak hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute dingto-in, Yerusalem-a biaknataute lakhia-in, paknamtui biaknataute zong hemkhia-in Kidron Kuam sungah a paai uh hi;

Tua ciangin Kha Nihna kha, a ni Sawm le Li ni-in amaute in Paisan tuunote go uh hi. Siampite leh Levi-te a maizum uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute ki-apin kisiansuah uh a, tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn ah meihal biaknate a paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh’ mipa Mosheh tungtawnin a piak Thukham sunga om mah bangin amaute in amau panmun ngei mah luahin, Levi mite khut panin a san uh sisante a theh uh hi.

Mihonte lakah amau mahmah a kisiansuah nai lo tampi om ahih manin Yahweh tungah amau tuunote a pia thei lo, biakna ngeina-in a siang lo mite khempeuh aa ding leh Levi mite in Paisan tuunote a gawh ding uh ahi hi.

Tua lai-ah mi honpi khat om a, amau leh amau a kisiansuah nai lo a phadiakin Ephraim, Menahsheh, Issachar leh Zebulun hi uh a, tua hi napi-in a kigelhsa thu tawh kilehbulhin amaute in Paisan an a ne uh hi. Ahih hangin Hezekyah in amaute aa dingin thungetsakin, “Mawh maisakna a nei Yahweh aw,
munsiangtho a siantho ngeina tawh kituakin amah a sian loh hangin ka pate uh Pa ahi Pa Yahweh a zong dingin a lungsim a khentat mipa maisak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Hezekyah ngetna za-in mite a damsak hi.

Tua khit ciangin Yerusalem-a om Israyl mite in lungnopna lianpi tawh ni sagih sung Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi bawl uh a, Levi-te leh siampite in Yahweh phatna-a a kizang tumgingte gingsakkikin ni khat khit ni khat la tawh Yahweh a phat uh hi.

Hezekyah in Yahweh nasep makaihna ah amau theihtelna a lakkhia Levi mite khempeuh zong a phat hi. Amaute in Pawi an ni sagih sung tawntung a nek khit uh ciangin—kilemna biaknate pia-in, Amah biakna leh zahtakna tawh a khutte uh zaakin Yahweh a phat hun sungin—
mihon buppi in ni sagih sung mah Pawi a bawl beh lai ding uh thukim uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in nuamna tawh ni sagih sung a bawl beh uh hi.
Kumpi Hezekyah in mihon buppi tungah bawngtal 1,000, tuu 7,000 pia a, uliante in amaute tungah bawngtal 1,000 leh tuu 10,000 pia-in, siampi tampitak amau le amau ki-apin a kisiansuah uh hi.
Siampite leh Levi-te a kihel, Israyl gam panin hong pai Israyl mihonte leh, Yahdah gam sunga teng mite ahi Yahweh’ mihon buppi in nuam a sa mahmah uh hi.
Yerusalem ah nuamna lianpi om hi. Israyl kumpi David’ tapa Solomon huna kipanin Yerusalem ah hih bang om ngei lo hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi siampite dingto-in mipite thupha a pia hi; tua ciangin Yahweh in amaute thu ngai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute thungetna in a siangtho Ama tenna mun vantung dong ban hi.

Hih khempeuh a man khit ciangin, Yahdah khuapite panin tua lai-a om Israyl khempeuh paikhia-in, a siangtho khuampite sukham uh a, a siangtho khuamte satnenin, mun sangte tunga om innte leh biaknataute a sucim uh hi. Amaute in Yahdah, Benyamin, Ephraim leh Menasheh gam khempeuh ah hih bangin a hih uh hi. Tuate khempeuh a suksiat kiuhkeuh khit uh ciangin Israyl mite amau khuapi ciat ah ciahin mi khempeuh amau tenna ciat ah a ciah uh hi.

Hezekyah in siampite leh Levi-te amau nasep ciat tawh kizui-in a khenkhenin seh hi. Siampite leh Levi-te pen meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia ding, biak nasep a sem ding, Yahweh’ Min phawkna dingin a sam ding, leh Yahweh’ Inn a tualte ah lungdam kohna leh phatna a pia dingte ahi uh hi.

Kumpipa in ama neihsa sehtanh khat zong meihal biaknate-a nasep nadingin pia hi; tuate pen: Yahweh’ Thukham sungah a kigelh mah bangin Zingsang leh Nitak Tamid; a kizom den nisim meihal biaknate; Shabbat nite, Kha Thak nite leh a kisehsa Yahweh’ Pawi hunte-a meihal biaknate ahi hi.
Yahweh’ Thukham tawh Siampite leh Levi-te a tuam deuhin a kiletkip theih nadingin Yerusalem-a teng mite in siampite leh Levi-te panpihna-in siah a piak nadingun Hezekyah in thu a pia hi.
Thupiakna a kitangko phetin, Israyl mite in a anpalte, leenggahzu, sathau, khuaizu leh lo pana piang khempeuh tampitak a puak uh hi. Amaute in na khempeuh ah sawma khat tampitak a paipih uh hi.
Yahdah gam sunga teng Israyl mite leh Yahdah mite in bawngtalte leh tuute pana sawma khat, Yahweh a Pa uh tunga a ki-ap a siangtho nate pana sawma khatte puakin, amaute in a lom lomin a ciang uh hi.
A Kha Thumna kha-in amaute in a kiciangsate kaihkhop ding kipan uh a, a Kha Sagihna kha-in a zo uh hi.
Hezekyah leh a uliante in hih a lompite a muh uh ciangin amaute in Yahweh phatin Ama mi Israyl-te thupha a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekyah in siampite leh Levi-te kiangah a lompite’ thu a dong hi.

Tua ciangin Zadok’ innkuan panin Siampi Lian Azaryah in ama kiangah, “Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn ah huhnate puak ding hong kipat uh a kipanin nek ding kicing denin tampi vallai hi. Yahweh in a mite thupha pia-in, hih zahtak a vallai hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekyah in Yahweh’ Inn ah vankholna inndeite a bawl nadingin thupia a, tua ciangin amaute in tuate a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in huhnate, sawma khatte leh a ki-ap nate citak takin a paipih uh hi. Levi mi Conanyah pen hih nate a uk dingin kiseh a, tua ciangin a sanggampa Shimei pen amah a huhpa ahi hi.

Kumpipa Hezekyah leh Yahweh’ Inn-a thunei ulian Azaryah thupiakna tawh Conanyah leh a sanggampa Shimei ukna nuai-a nasep ukte pen: Yehiel, Azazyah, Nahath, Asahel, Yerimoth, Yahzabad, Eliel, Ismachyah, Mahath leh Benayah ahi uh hi.
Nisuahna lam Kongpi cing Levi mi Imnah’ tapa Kore pen Yahweh’ tunga uttawmna hanga biaknate a ukpa leh Yahweh tunga panpihna a kipiate leh a ki-ap nate a ukpa ahi hi.

Siampi khuapite sunga a citakin a kician amah a huhte pen Eden, Minyamin, Yahshua, Shemayah, Amaryah, leh Shecanyah hi a, amaute in a sanggamte uh tungah amau khenkhen zui-in a moi a hamin hihte a hawm uh hi.

Tua banah khangsimna ah a kiciamteh, amau tavuan ciat leh amau khenkhen ciat tawh kizui-in nisima amau nasem nam tuamtuamte a sem dingin Yahweh’ Inn ah a lut kum sawmthum pan a tungsiah pasalte tungah zong amaute in a hawm uh hi.
Khangsimna ah a behzui-in a kiciamteh siampite tungah zong amaute in pia uh a, kum sawmnih leh a tungsiah a pha Levi mite zong amau tavuan ciat leh amau pawl ciat zui-in a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a ki-apna uhah citak ahih manin amau mihon buppi ahi a taneute, a zite, a tapate leh a tanute a vekpi-un zum khangsimna ah a kihel kim uh hi.

Amau khuapi’ neihkhop-gamte sunga leitangte ah a teng Aaron suan siampite in siampite laka pasal khempeuh tung leh Levi-te zum khangsimna sunga kihel khempeuh tungah sehtanhte a hawm thei pah ding khuapi kim ah mi minthangte a nei uh hi.
Hezekyah in Yahdah gam sung khempeuh ah hih bangin hih a, Yahweh a Pa mai-ah phattuamna a nei, a hoih, a manin a sem hi.
Yahweh’ Inn nasepna ah vaipuak a lak nasep khatpeuh leh, Thukham leh thupiaknate zuihna ah amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh Yahweh zong a, amah a mavang hi.
Hih cihtak nasepnate khempeuh khit ciangin, Assyria kumpi Sennacherib kuanto-in Yahdah a sim hi. Amah in kulhnei khuapite umcihin, ama aa dingin amaute a zo dingin a kingaihsun hi.
Sennacherib hong pai-in Yerusalem sim ding a sawmna thu Hezekyah in a theih ciangin,
amah in khuapi pualam a pia tuinakte khak ding thu a uliante leh galkap mangte kuppih a, amaute in amah a huh uh hi.
Mi tampi tak kikhawm uh a, gam sunga a luang tuinak leh lui khempeuh khakcipin, “Assyria kumpite hong pai-in tui tampi bang hangin mu ding ahi uh hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Amah in khensatna tawh na sem a, kulh kisiatna mun khempeuh puahpha-in, a tungah tausangte lam a, tua khit ciangin tua pualam ah kulh dang khat zong a lamin David’ Khuapi sunga Millo a khuahsak kik hi. Amah in galhiamte leh lumte zong tampitak a bawl hi.
Amah in mite a uk dingin galkap uliante seh a, khuapi kulhkongpi mun awnna ama kiangah amaute a sam hi. Amah in amaute hanthawnin, a gen inah:
“Thahat unla, hang un! Assyria kumpipa leh amah tawh hong pai mi honpi khempeuh mai-ah lau kei unla, lungkia kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh amah tawh a omte sangin ei tawh a omte tamzaw hi!

Amah tawh a omte pen cilesa galkapte bek hi lel a, ahih hangin ei tawh Yahweh i Pa om a, amah in eite hong huhin i galte hong dosak ding hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah’ kammalte in mipite a thangahsak hi.

Hih thu khit ciangin Assyria kumpi Sennacherib in Yerusalem leh Hezekyah leh amah tawh a om Yahdah mi khempeuh kiangah a uliante sawlin, (Ahih hangin amah leh a galkapte in ama thupiakna tawh Lachish a umcih uh hi), a nuai-a thute a puaksak hi:
Hih in Assyria kumpi Sennacherib gen ahi hi: Yerusalem-a umcihna nuai-ah na omlai uh bang bukna muang na hi uh hiam?
Note gilkial dangtaakin na sih theih nadingun Hezekyah in, “Yahweh eite Pa in Assyria kumpipa’ khut sung panin eite hong hon ding hi,” ci-in note hong khem hilo ahi hiam?
Hih Hezekyah mah in Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte leh biaknataute hemkhia-in, “Biaknatau khat mai-ah bia hamtangin tua tung bek ah paknamtui hal ding,” a cipa hilo ahi hiam?
Kei leh ka pate in gamdanga mite khempeuh tungah ka hihnasate uh thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua minamte pasiante (elohim) in keima khut panin amau gam honkhia zo ngei ahi hiam?
Ka pate suksiat hih minamte pasiante khempeuh lak panin kua in keima kiang panin a mite honkhia thei ahi hiam? Tua hi a, keima khut panin no pasian (el) in hong koici hot theih ding ahi hiam?

Tua ahih ciangin note hong khem dingin Hezekyah phal kei unla, hih bangin kikhemsak kei un! Amah um kei un! Minam khatpeuh ahih keileh kumpigam khatpeuh’ pasian in keima khut pan ahi a, ka pate khut pan ahi zongin a mite honkhia zo ngei nai lo hi! Tua hi a, keima khut panin no pasian in nakpi-in hong hu zo lozaw tham ding hi!’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
A uliante in Hezekyah’ Pa Yahweh leh Yahweh’ nasem Hezekyah langpanin a uangzaw thamin a gensia hi.

Amah in zong Israyl’ Pa Yahweh gensiatna laikhakte gelhin, “Minamte pasiante in ka khut sung panin amau mite a hotkhiat loh mah bangin Hezekyah’ pasian (el) in zong ka khut panin a mite honkhia lo ding hi,” ci-in Amah a gensia hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in khuapi a laktheih nadingin khua sung mite lau-in a linglawnsak nadingun kulh tunga om Yerusalem mite tungah Hebrew kam tawh nakpitakin a kiko uh hi.
Amaute in mite khut tawh a kibawl leitung mite pasiante (elohim) a gen bang lel-un Yerusalem’ Pa a gen uh hi.
Hih thu hangin tu-in Kumpi Hezekyah leh Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah in thungenin, vantunga Yahweh lamah a kiko uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in vantungmi sawl a, amah in galkap khempeuh leh Assyria kumpipa giahphual sunga makaite leh galkap bute a susia hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama gam ah maizumna tawh a ciahkik hi. Tua ciangin ama pasian (el) inn sungah a lut ciangin a tapate pawlkhat in namsau tawh a sattuk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib’ khut pan leh adang khempeuh khut panin Hezekyah leh Yerusalem mite hon a, tua ciangin Amah in amaute a kiimkot ah galdaihna a pia hi.

Tua ciangin mi tampi in Yerusalem, Yahweh kiangah biaknate puak uh a, Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah kiangah a manpha letsongte a puak uh hi. Tua hun a kipanin minam khempeuh-a mite’ mit ah amah nakpitakin a kitawisang hi.
Tua hunin Hezekyah a cina-in si dektak hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in Yahweh kiangah thungen a, Yahweh in amah dawngin lim khat a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Hezekyah kiphasak a, ama ngah phattuamna tawh kizui-in amah in a dawngkik nuam kei hi. Hih thu hangin ama tung, leh Yahdah leh Yerusalem tungah Yahweh’ hehna a tung ding ahi ta hi.
Ahih hangin Yerusalem mite mah bangin Hezekyah amahmah kiniamkhiatin, ama lungtang kiphatsakna hangin kisik hi; tua ahih ciangin Hezekyah’ nuntak hun sungin amaute tungah Yahweh’ hehna a tung kei hi.
Hezekyah hong hau mahmah ta a, nakpi-in a kipahtawi hi. Amah in a ngun, kham, suang manphate, gimnamtuite, lumte leh van manpha nam khempeuh koih nadingin a bawl hi.
Amah in an kaikhopte, leenggahzu, leh sathau khol nading innte zong lamin, Ganhon nam khempeuh aa dingin ganbukte leh tuuhonte aa dingin tuubuk a bawl hi.
Amah in tua bangmahin amahmah aa dingin khuapite leh tuuhonte leh ganhonte tampi a koih hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in amah hauhna lianpi a pia hi.
Hih Hezekyah mah in Gihon Tungnunga tuite khaktanin, David Khuapi nitumna lampang ah lei kivut let tawnin tui a luangsak hi. Hezekyah a nasepna khempeuh ah a mavang hi.
Ahih hangin Babylon ukpite in uliante sawlin gam sunga piang lim a dot ciangin Amah in ama lungsim sunga om khempeuh a theih nadingin amah ze-et dingin ama kiang panin Yahweh nungkik hi.
Tu-in Hezekyah uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite leh itna tawh a septe, Amoz’ tapa kamsang Isayah mangmuhna sung leh Yahdah leh Israyl kumpite laibu sungah a kigelh hi.

Tua hi a, Hezekyah a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in David’ suante’ han tungnung ah amah a vui uh hi. Amah a sih ciangin Yahdah khempeuh leh Yerusalem mite in amah a pahtawi uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Menasheh in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Menasheh kumpi a suahin amah kum sawm le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmnga le kum nga uk hi.
Ahih hangin amah Yahweh mit ah a sia-in gamta-in, Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a hawlkhiat minamte a kihhuai gamtatnate a zui hi.

A pa Hezekyah in a sukcimsa Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte ama’n lamkik hi. Amah in Baal-te aa dingin biaknataute dingsak a, Asherah Khuamte bawlin, vantunga a honpite khempeuh bia-in tuate’ na a sem hi.
Yahweh in, “Yerusalem ah Ka Min om tawntung ding hi,” ci-in a genna Yahweh’ Inn ah biaknataute zong amah in lam hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ Inn a tual nih tuak ah vantunga a honpi khempeuh aa dingin biaknataute zong a lam hi.

Amah in Ben Hinnom-a Kuam sungah a tapate meikuang sungah biakpiakna-in a pia a, amah in thumuh kholhna, aisanna leh khongkhaina zangin, vankah-te leh kha tawh a kizawlte thu a dong hi. Amah in Yahweh mit ah siatna tampi bawlin Amah a hehsak hi.

-8 Yahweh in David kiang leh a tapa Solomon kiangah, “Hih inn sung leh Israyl minam khempeuh panin ka telsa Yerusalem sungah Ka Min ka kipsak tawntung ding hi. Mosheh tungtawna kipia biakna ngeinate leh ngeina kipte leh Thukham buppi tawh kizui-in amaute in amaute tunga thu ka piak khempeuh limtakin zui-in a sep laiteng, na pate uh a tungah a ding dingin ka phalna leitang panin Israyl’ khe ka hemkhia kik kei ding hi,” ci-in a genna Yahweh’ Inn sung ah a kiseek Asherah nusian nangawn a koih hi.
Ahih hangin Menasheh in Yahdah-te leh Yerusalem mite paikhialhpih hi; tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in Israyl mite mai panin a suksiat minamte sangin amaute a siazaw-in a gamta uh hi.
Yahweh in Menasheh leh a mite hopih a, ahih hangin amaute in a ngai nuam kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahweh in amaute langah Assyria kumpipa’ galkap ukte puak a, amaute in Menasheh manin, a nak ah sikkawi thuah uh a, sumngo kolte tawh amah bulhin Babylon ah a la uh hi.
Ama thuak hun sungin amah in Yahweh a Pa kiang thuum ngeungau a, a pate uh Pa Yahweh mai-ah nakpitakin amahmah kiniamkhiatin,

Ama kiangah thu a ngen hi. Ama kutna in Yahweh kiheisakin, ama thuumna a ngai hi. Tua ciangin Amah in Yerusalem ama kumpigam ah amah paipihkik hi. Tua ciangin Menasheh in Yahweh pen Vanglianpen Yahweh a hihna thei hi.

Hih khit ciangin amah in kuam sung Gihon Tuinak nitumna lam David Khuapi kulh a pualam, Ngasa Kongpi lutna ciang dong lampha a, Ophel mual kiimvelsakin, a sangzaw thamin a bawl hi. Amah in Yahdah khuapi muanhuaite khempeuh ah galkap uliante a koih hi.

Amah in Yahweh’ Inn panin gamdang pasiante (elohim) leh Asherah milim leh, Yahweh’ Inn mual tung leh Yerusalem sunga a lamsa biaknatau khempeuh a hemkhia hi; amah in khuapi panin tuate khempeuh a paaikhia hi.
Amah in Yahweh’ biaknatau puahpha-in, tua tungah kilemna biaknate leh lungdamna biakna a pia hi; tua ciangin Yahdah-te in Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh’ na a sep nadingin thu a pia hi.
Ahi ta zongin mite in mun sangte ah biakpiakna pia lai uh hi; ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh a Pa tung bek ah a pia uh hi.
Tu-in Menasheh uk hun sunga thupiang a omlaite, Yahweh tunga ama thungetna leh Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh’ Min tawh ama tunga thu a gen thumute’ thugente, Israyl kumpite laibu sungah kigelh hi.

Tua ciangin ama thungetna, leh ama kutna Yahweh in a sanna, leh ama mawhna khempeuh, a gamtatkhialhna, a khialhna, leh Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte a lamna munte, leh amah a kiniamkhiat ma-a Asherah Khuamte leh pasiante (elohim) limte a koihna munte’ thu, thumute’ ciaptehnate lakah a kigelh taktak hi.
Tua hi a, Menasheh a pate tawh ihmu a, amaute in ama inn mah ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Amon in a kumpi’ za a luah hi.
Amon kumpi a suahin amah kum sawmnih le kum nih pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum nih uk hi.
A pa Menasheh gamtatsa bang teekteekin amah Yahweh mit-ah a sia-in gamta hi. Amon in Menasheh’ bawlsa pasiante (elohim) limte ah biakna a pia-in tuate’ na a sem hi.
Ahih hangin a pa Menasheh amahmah a kiniamkhiat bangin Yahweh mai-ah amah kiniamkhiat lo hi. Hih Amon in a khialhna a khangsak semsem hi.
Tua ciangin a uliante in amah sawmsimin, ama inn sung mah ah a that uh hi.
Ahi zongin gam sung mite in kumpi Amon a sawmsim mite khempeuh that uh hi. Tua ciangin gam sung mite in ama mun ah kumpi-in a tapa Yoshiyah a bawl uh hi.
Yoshiyah kumpi a suahin amah kum giat pha a, amah in Yerusalem ah kum sawmthum le kum khat uk hi.
Amah Yahweh’ mit ah a manin gam ta a, a pa David’ lampite khempeuh a zui hi. Amah taklam ahi a, veilam ahi zongin pial lo hi;

Ama uk zawh a kum giatna kum, ama khangno lai a hipi mahin, amah in a pa David’ Pa a zong hi. Tua ciangin ama uk zawh a kum sawm le nihna kumin amah in Yahdah leh Yerusalem panin Mun Sangte tawh a kop Innte, Asherah Khuamte leh a kikhuak a kisung pasiante (elohim) limte beisiangsak dingin a kipan hi.

Amaute in Baal-te biaknataute ama om mahin sucim a, tuate tunga om paknamtui biaknataute satnen hi; tua ciangin Asherah Khuamte leh a kikhuak a kisung pasiante (elohim) limte amah in suzanin, leivui a suah dongin gawivui a, tuate tungah biakpiakna a pia mite hante tungah tua a vuite a thehmang hi.
Amah in amau biaknataute tungah siampite guhte zong halin, tua ciangin Yahdah leh Yerusalem a siangsak hi.
Tua ciangin Menasheh, Ephraim, Simeon khuapite leh Naphtali khuapi ciang dong, mun awngte leh a kiim a pam ah,

Amah in biaknataute leh Asherah Khuamte balkhia-in, a kiseek milimte leivui a suah dongin suvui a, gam sung khempeuh-a paknamtui biaknataute khempeuh a satpuk hi. Tua khit ciangin Yerusalem ah amah a ciahkik hi.

Ama uk zawh a kum sawm le kum giatna kum, amah in gam sung leh Yahweh’ Inn a siatsak khit ciangin, amah in a Pa Yahweh’ Inn a puahpha dingin Azalyah’ tapa Shaphan, khuapi uk Maaseyah leh Yahahaz’ tapa thuciamteh Yahach a sawl hi.

Siampi Lian Hilkiyah kiangah Levi mi kongcingte a tun uh ciangin Menasheh, Ephraim-te khut pan, Israyl minam a omlaisun khempeuh kiang pan, Yahdah leh Benyamin-te khempeuh kiang pan, leh Yerusalem mite kiang panin a khop uh ahi Yahweh’ Inn sunga a paipih uh sumte Levi mi kongcingte in a pia uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn nasepna a vaan mite tungah tua sumte pia uh hi. Hih mite in Yahweh’ Inn puahpha-in a ngei mah a bangsakkik nasemte a pia uh hi.
Yahdah kumpite in thudon loin a kisiatsak uh innte puah nadingin amaute in suangseeksa leh innkamna singte a lei nadingun khutsiamte leh innlamte tungah a pia hi.

Mi khempeuh in a nasep uh citak takin sem uh hi. Na sepna vaan lamlakte pen Levi mite ahi uh hi. Amaute pen: Merari’ gui panin Yachath leh Obadyah hi a, Kohath’ gui panin Zecharyah leh Meshullam ahi hi. Levi mi, tumging tum siamte khempeuh in—
aana tawh na kisemsakte ukin, nasem nam khempeuh a vaan uh hi. Levi mi kimkhat pen lai-atte, uliante leh kongpi cingte ahi uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn sungah a kipaipih sumte a puakkhiat uh ciangin, Siampi Lian Hilkiyah in Mosheh tungtawna kipia Yahweh’ Thukham Laibu a mu hi.
Hilkiyah in lai-at Shaphan kiangah hih thu puakin, “Yahweh’ Inn sungah Thukham Laibu ka mu hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Hilkiyah in Shaphan kiangah tua Laibu a pia hi.
Shaphan in ama thupuak a ko dingin a pai ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah tua Laibu a pua hi. Amah in, “Na uliante in a sep dingin na seh khempeuh, amaute in sem lai uh hi.
Amaute in Yahweh’ Inn sunga om sumte khawmkhin uh a, nasep vaante in nasem mite a piak theih nadingun nasep vaante tungah a piakhin uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Shaphan in kumpipa kiangah, “Siampi Lian Hilkiyah in keima tungah Laibu khat hong pia hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shaphan in kumpipa omin tua Laibu a sim hi.
Kumpipa in Thukham kammalte a zak phetin, amah in a puante balkek hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Hilkiyah, Shaphan’ tapa Ahikam, Micahyah’ tapa Abdon, lai-at Shaphan leh kumpipa ulian khat ahi Asayah kiangah hih thupiaknate pia a,

“Pai unla, a kimukik hih Laibu sunga kigelh thute tawh kisai-in kei aa ding leh, Israyl leh Yahdah sunga omlai mite aa dingin Yahweh kiangah thu dong un. Puan koihna a cing Harhas’ tapa Tikvah, a tapa Shullum zi kamsang numei Huldah kiangah kumpipa seh mite tawh Hilkiyah a pai hi. Tuanu pen Yerusalem sung Veng Nihna ah a teng hi. Amaute in a hawhna thu uh gen a,
Tua ciangin tuanu in amaute kiangah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in hih bangin ci hi: Kei kiangah note hong sawl mipa kiangah gen un:
Yahweh cih hih bang ahi hi: En un, hih mun leh a mite tungah Yahdah kumpipa om mahin a kisim Laibu sunga kigelh samsiatna khempeuh ahi siatna ka tun ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh a kikham pasiante (elohim) tungah paknamtui halin tua ahih manin amau khutin a septe khempeuh uh tawh Kei hong hehsak theih nadingun amaute in Kei hong taisan uh hi. Hih thu hangin hih mun ah Ka hehna ka buasuk ding a, tua ciangin dai nawn lo ding hi,’ ci hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh kiangah thu dong dingin note hong sawl Yahdah kumpipa ahih leh, note in a nuai-a bangin ama kiangah na gen ding uh hi: Hih in na zaksa thute tawh kisai-in Yahweh, Israyl’ Pa thugen ahi hi:

Hih mun leh a mite langpanin Ama thugente na zak ciangin Yahweh mai-ah na lungsim khiamin nang mahmah zong kiniamkhiat na hih manin—Keima mai-ah nang kiniamkhiatin, na puante balkekin, Ka omna ah thuum na hih manin—Keimah in zong nang kong za hi, Yahweh in ci hi.

Kumpipa in Yahdah leh Yerusalem upate khempeuh a sam khawm hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh’ Inn ah kumpipa, Yahdah mite khempeuh leh Yerusalem mite, siampite leh Levi mite, a neupen panin a lianpen dong mi khempeuh a paito uh hi. Amah in amaute zakin Yahweh’ Inn sunga kimukik Thuciamna Laibu sunga thute khempeuh a sim hi.

Amah in siampite amau nasepna mun ah seh a, Yahweh’ Inn-a amau nasepnate ah amaute a hanthawn hi.

Israyl kumpi David’ gelhsa leh a tapa Solomon’ gelhsa bangin na innkuan zui-in a khenkhenin kigual un.
Mi nautang na sanggamte uh pate’ innkuan zui-a kikhenna tawh kizui-in Yahweh’ Inn a tual ah ding un; tua hileh innkuan khen khat ciat aa dingin nasem dingin a mansa-in Levi mite om ding uh hi.

Tua bangin nasepna a kigeel hi. A khenkhente tawh kizui-in kumpipa thupiakna bangin biaknatau phung ah siampite dingin, inntual ah Levi-te ding uh hi.

Hih khempeuh khit, Yoshiyah in Yahweh’ Inn limtakin a bawl khit ciangin, Euphrates gei-a Carchemish ah galsim dingin Egypt kumpipa Necho hong kuanto a, amah a do dingin Yoshiyah a kuankhia hi.
